declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {W : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.WeightData},
  S.resolved = Finset.Icc (-↑W.J) ↑W.J →
    S.band = Finset.Icc (-↑(W.J + W.JB)) ↑(W.J + W.JB) \ Finset.Icc (-↑W.J) ↑W.J →
      (∀ (n : ℤ), S.energyWeight n = W.energy) →
        (∀ (n : ℤ), S.vorticityWeight n = W.vorticity) →
          (∀ (n : ℤ), S.tailShift n = if n ∈ S.resolved then W.shift else 0) →
            (∀ (n : ℤ),
                S.curlAbsorb n =
                  if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedCurl else if n ∈ S.band then W.curlBand else W.curlOut) →
              (∀ (n : ℤ),
                  S.strainAbsorb n =
                    if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedStrain
                    else W.strainAt K S (W.kEff c.order n) (decide (n ∈ S.band))) →
                (∀ (n : ℤ), S.velocityAbsorb n = if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedVelocity else 0) →
                  (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                      S.symWeight n j l =
                        S.energyWeight n *
                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K j l +
                                K.angularWeight n *
                                  max (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n - 2) 0 ^ 2) -
                            S.strainAbsorb n -
                          S.tailShift n) →
                    (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                        S.antiWeight n j l =
                          (S.energyWeight n + 2 * S.vorticityWeight n) *
                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K j l +
                                    K.angularWeight n *
                                      max (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n - 1) 0 ^ 2) -
                                2 * S.curlAbsorb n -
                              S.strainAbsorb n -
                            S.tailShift n) →
                      (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                          S.velWeight n j l =
                            (S.tailShift n *
                                if S.degHigh ≤ j then Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen K j
                                else Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen K l) -
                              S.velocityAbsorb n) →
                        Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm c K S W

    (∀ (b : Fin T.pieceCount),
        0 ≤ T.pieceRhoLo b ∧
          (∀ (h : ℝ), T.pieceRhoHi b = some h → T.pieceRhoLo b ≤ h) ∧
            0 ≤ T.pieceZLo b ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ), T.pieceZHi b = some h → T.pieceZLo b ≤ h) →
      0 < T.chartScale →
        (∀ (b : Fin T.pieceCount) (t₀ t₁ x₀ x₁ : ℝ),
            T.pieceChart b = some (t₀, t₁, x₀, x₁) →
              0 ≤ x₀ ∧
                ∀ y ∈ Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.chartSolid T.chartScale t₀ t₁ x₀ x₁,
                  T.pieceRhoLo b ≤ Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.horizontalNorm y ∧
                    (∀ (h : ℝ), T.pieceRhoHi b = some h → Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.horizontalNorm y ≤ h) ∧
                      T.pieceZLo b ≤ y.ofLp 2 ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ), T.pieceZHi b = some h → y.ofLp 2 ≤ h) →
          (∀ (b : Fin T.pieceCount), 0 ≤ T.pieceSup b) →
            (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), 0 ≤ y.ofLp 2 → ∃ b, y ∈ T.pieceSolid b) →
              (∀ (ρ z : ℝ),
                  0 ≤ ρ →
                    0 ≤ z →
                      ∃ a,
                        T.boxRhoLo a ≤ ρ ∧
                          (∀ (h : ℝ), T.boxRhoHi a = some h → ρ ≤ h) ∧
                            T.boxZLo a ≤ z ∧ ∀ (h : ℝ), T.boxZHi a = some h → z ≤ h) →
                (∀ (a : Fin T.boxCount), 0 ≤ T.boxRhoLo a ∧ 0 ≤ T.boxZLo a) →

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellNumbers.recOn
declarations.type:
{α : ℝ} →
  {k N : ℕ} →
    {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} →
      {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellNumbers α c → Sort u} →
        (t : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellNumbers α c) →
          ((innerWeight_nonneg : 0 ≤ c.innerWeight) →
              (innerWeight_le : c.innerWeight ≤ c.splitVisc) →
                (velocityLoss_bound :
                    ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), √(c.cellWeight y) * ‖c.velocityError y‖ ≤ c.velocityLoss) →
                  (actuatorGradLoss_bound :
                      ∑ i,
                          ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                            Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (c.actuatorGrad i y - c.modelActuatorGrad i y) ≤
                        c.actuatorGradLoss ^ 2) →
                    (actuatorLoss_bound :
                        ∑ i, (c.rows fun y => c.actuator i y - c.modelActuator i y) ^ 2 ≤ c.actuatorLoss ^ 2) →
                      (pinFieldLoss_bound :
                          ∑ i, ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (c.pin i y - c.modelPinField i y) ≤
                            c.pinFieldLoss ^ 2) →
                        (losses_nonneg' :
                            0 ≤ c.centreLoss ∧
                              0 ≤ c.rateLoss ∧
                                0 ≤ c.strainLoss ∧
                                  0 ≤ c.curlGradLoss ∧
                                    0 ≤ c.velocityLoss ∧
                                      0 ≤ c.curlLoss ∧
                                        0 ≤ c.actuatorGradLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.actuatorLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.pinFieldLoss) →
                          (potLoss_ge :
                              c.centreLoss + (c.strainLoss + √(7 / 2) * c.curlGradLoss) / c.weightMin +
                                  c.actuatorGradLoss / (2 * c.multiplierScale * √c.weightMin) ≤
                                c.potLoss) →
                            (rowLoss_ge :
                                √c.rowMax * c.centreLoss + c.rateLoss + (c.velocityLoss + c.curlLoss) / √c.weightMin +
                                    c.actuatorLoss / c.multiplierScale ≤
                                  c.rowLoss) →
                              (pinLoss_ge : c.pinFieldLoss / √c.weightMin ≤ c.pinLoss) →
                                (rowWeight_block :
                                    ∀ (a b : Fin N), c.blockIndex a = c.blockIndex b → c.rowWeight a = c.rowWeight b) →
                                  (baseCoef_nonneg : 0 ≤ c.baseCoef) →
                                    (levelCoef_nonneg : ∀ (i : Fin c.levelCount), 0 ≤ c.levelCoef i) →
                                      (levelRate_pos : ∀ (i : Fin c.levelCount), 0 < c.levelRate i) →
                                        (cutoff_ge : c.splitVisc ^ (1 / (α - 1)) ≤ c.cutoff) →
                                          (symbol_fit :
                                              ∀ (x : ℝ), 0 < x → x ≤ c.cutoff → c.ratioSymbol α x ≤ c.levelSum x) →
                                            (symbol_end :
                                                c.gapSymbol α c.cutoff ^ 2 /
                                                    (c.gapSymbol α c.cutoff + c.reducedCoercivity) ≤
                                                  c.levelSum c.cutoff) →
                                              (splitBound_ge :
                                                  ∀ (a : Fin N),
                                                    c.rowWeight a *
                                                        (c.baseCoef +
                                                            ∑ i,
                                                              c.levelCoef i *
                                                                c.spectralBound (c.blockIndex a) (c.levelRate i) +
                                                          (α - 1) * c.tailConst * c.cutoff ^ (α - 1 - 1 / 2) /
                                                            (1 / 2 - (α - 1))) ≤
                                                      c.splitBound ^ 2) →
                                                motive ⋯) →
            motive t

                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment L.gauge ∧ L.gauge.testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ L.gauge.lo →
                        (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                            (L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                ((L.segment s).level = K.r₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.r₂) ∧
                                  K.z₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧ (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.z₂ ∧ (L.segment s).level ≠ 0 ∨
                              ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                ((L.segment s).level = K.z₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.z₂) ∧
                                  K.r₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧ (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →
                          (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                              ((L.segment s).radial = true → (L.segment s).other = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.segment s).level) ∧
                                (¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                  (L.segment s).other = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.segment s).level)) →
                            (∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                ((L.corner c).1 = K.r₁ ∨ (L.corner c).1 = K.r₂) ∧
                                  ((L.corner c).2 = K.z₁ ∨ (L.corner c).2 = K.z₂) ∧ (L.corner c).1 ≠ 0) →
                              (∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                  (L.cornerOther c).1 = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.corner c).1 ∧
                                    (L.cornerOther c).2 = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.corner c).2) →
                                (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                    L.segEnd s e = some c →
                                      L.corner c =
                                        if (L.segment s).radial = true then
                                          ((L.segment s).level, if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi)
                                        else
                                          (if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi, (L.segment s).level)) →
                                  (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2),
                                      L.segEnd s e = none →
                                        ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧ e = 0 ∧ (L.segment s).lo = 0) →
                                    (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                        (L.segment s).radial = true → (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0) →
                                      (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                          ¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                            (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧ (L.segment s).testCoef 1 1 ≠ 0) →
                                        1 ≤ L.degSide →
                                          L.degSide + 1 ≤ L.degCoef →
                                            (∀ (i j : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                L.cellCorner i j = some c →
                                                  L.corner c =
                                                    (if i = 0 then K.r₁ else K.r₂, if j = 0 then K.z₁ else K.z₂)) →
                                              (∀ (i j : Fin 2), L.cellCorner i j = none → i = 0 ∧ K.r₁ = 0) →
                                                (∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                    ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                      ((L.segment s).radial = true ↔ ↑e < 2) ∧
                                                        (L.segment s).level =
                                                          if ↑e = 0 then K.r₁
                                                          else if ↑e = 1 then K.r₂ else if ↑e = 2 then K.z₁ else K.z₂) →
                                                  (∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                      (↑e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                                                        ∀ (u : ℝ),
                                                          (if ↑e < 2 then K.z₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.z₂
                                                            else K.r₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.r₂) →
                                                            ∃ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                              (L.segment s).lo ≤ u ∧ u ≤ (L.segment s).hi) →
                                                    (∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                        ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                          ∀ s' ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                            s ≠ s' →
                                                              (L.segment s).hi ≤ (L.segment s').lo ∨
                                                                (L.segment s').hi ≤ (L.segment s).lo) →
                                                      (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount), ∃ e, s ∈ L.sideSegments e) →
                                                        (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (d d' : ℕ),
                                                            d ≤ L.degSide + 1 →
                                                              d' ≤ L.degSide + 1 →
                                                                ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Icc (L.segment s).lo (L.segment s).hi,
                                                                    (L.segment s).test d u * (L.segment s).test d' u =
                                                                  if d = d' then 1 else 0) →
                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellNumbers.casesOn
declarations.type:
{α : ℝ} →
  {k N : ℕ} →
    {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} →
      {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellNumbers α c → Sort u} →
        (t : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellNumbers α c) →
          ((innerWeight_nonneg : 0 ≤ c.innerWeight) →
              (innerWeight_le : c.innerWeight ≤ c.splitVisc) →
                (velocityLoss_bound :
                    ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), √(c.cellWeight y) * ‖c.velocityError y‖ ≤ c.velocityLoss) →
                  (actuatorGradLoss_bound :
                      ∑ i,
                          ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                            Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (c.actuatorGrad i y - c.modelActuatorGrad i y) ≤
                        c.actuatorGradLoss ^ 2) →
                    (actuatorLoss_bound :
                        ∑ i, (c.rows fun y => c.actuator i y - c.modelActuator i y) ^ 2 ≤ c.actuatorLoss ^ 2) →
                      (pinFieldLoss_bound :
                          ∑ i, ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (c.pin i y - c.modelPinField i y) ≤
                            c.pinFieldLoss ^ 2) →
                        (losses_nonneg' :
                            0 ≤ c.centreLoss ∧
                              0 ≤ c.rateLoss ∧
                                0 ≤ c.strainLoss ∧
                                  0 ≤ c.curlGradLoss ∧
                                    0 ≤ c.velocityLoss ∧
                                      0 ≤ c.curlLoss ∧
                                        0 ≤ c.actuatorGradLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.actuatorLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.pinFieldLoss) →
                          (potLoss_ge :
                              c.centreLoss + (c.strainLoss + √(7 / 2) * c.curlGradLoss) / c.weightMin +
                                  c.actuatorGradLoss / (2 * c.multiplierScale * √c.weightMin) ≤
                                c.potLoss) →
                            (rowLoss_ge :
                                √c.rowMax * c.centreLoss + c.rateLoss + (c.velocityLoss + c.curlLoss) / √c.weightMin +
                                    c.actuatorLoss / c.multiplierScale ≤
                                  c.rowLoss) →
                              (pinLoss_ge : c.pinFieldLoss / √c.weightMin ≤ c.pinLoss) →
                                (rowWeight_block :
                                    ∀ (a b : Fin N), c.blockIndex a = c.blockIndex b → c.rowWeight a = c.rowWeight b) →
                                  (baseCoef_nonneg : 0 ≤ c.baseCoef) →
                                    (levelCoef_nonneg : ∀ (i : Fin c.levelCount), 0 ≤ c.levelCoef i) →
                                      (levelRate_pos : ∀ (i : Fin c.levelCount), 0 < c.levelRate i) →
                                        (cutoff_ge : c.splitVisc ^ (1 / (α - 1)) ≤ c.cutoff) →
                                          (symbol_fit :
                                              ∀ (x : ℝ), 0 < x → x ≤ c.cutoff → c.ratioSymbol α x ≤ c.levelSum x) →
                                            (symbol_end :
                                                c.gapSymbol α c.cutoff ^ 2 /
                                                    (c.gapSymbol α c.cutoff + c.reducedCoercivity) ≤
                                                  c.levelSum c.cutoff) →
                                              (splitBound_ge :
                                                  ∀ (a : Fin N),
                                                    c.rowWeight a *
                                                        (c.baseCoef +
                                                            ∑ i,
                                                              c.levelCoef i *
                                                                c.spectralBound (c.blockIndex a) (c.levelRate i) +
                                                          (α - 1) * c.tailConst * c.cutoff ^ (α - 1 - 1 / 2) /
                                                            (1 / 2 - (α - 1))) ≤
                                                      c.splitBound ^ 2) →
                                                motive ⋯) →
            motive t

declarations.type:
{k N : ℕ} →
  {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} →
    {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
      {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} →
        {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases} →
          {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout} →
            {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L → Sort u} →
              (t : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L) →
                ((order_eq : L.order = c.order) →
                    (box_eq : L.box = K) →
                      (bases_eq : L.bases = B) →
                        (modes_eq : L.modes = S.resolved) →
                          (degCoef_eq : L.degCoef = S.degHigh) →
                            (degSide_eq : L.degSide = S.degLow) →
                              (box_valid : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBox K) →
                                (bases_valid : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBases K B) →
                                  (segment_valid :
                                      ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (L.segment s)) →
                                    (presSegment_valid :
                                        ∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (L.presSegment s)) →
                                      (gauge_valid :
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment L.gauge ∧
                                            L.gauge.testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ L.gauge.lo) →
                                        (segment_on_side :
                                            ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                              (L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                                  ((L.segment s).level = K.r₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.r₂) ∧
                                                    K.z₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧
                                                      (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.z₂ ∧ (L.segment s).level ≠ 0 ∨
                                                ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                                  ((L.segment s).level = K.z₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.z₂) ∧
                                                    K.r₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧ (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →
                                          (segment_other_in_box :
                                              ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                ((L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                    (L.segment s).other = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.segment s).level) ∧
                                                  (¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                    (L.segment s).other = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.segment s).level)) →
                                            (corner_is_corner :
                                                ∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                  ((L.corner c).1 = K.r₁ ∨ (L.corner c).1 = K.r₂) ∧
                                                    ((L.corner c).2 = K.z₁ ∨ (L.corner c).2 = K.z₂) ∧
                                                      (L.corner c).1 ≠ 0) →
                                              (corner_other :
                                                  ∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                    (L.cornerOther c).1 = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.corner c).1 ∧
                                                      (L.cornerOther c).2 = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.corner c).2) →
                                                (segEnd_spec :
                                                    ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                      L.segEnd s e = some c →
                                                        L.corner c =
                                                          if (L.segment s).radial = true then
                                                            ((L.segment s).level,
                                                              if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi)
                                                          else
                                                            (if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi,
                                                              (L.segment s).level)) →
                                                  (segEnd_axis :
                                                      ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2),
                                                        L.segEnd s e = none →
                                                          ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧ e = 0 ∧ (L.segment s).lo = 0) →
                                                    (radial_test_const :
                                                        ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                          (L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                            (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0) →
                                                      (height_test_affine :
                                                          ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                            ¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                              (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                                                                (L.segment s).testCoef 1 1 ≠ 0) →
                                                        (degSide_pos : 1 ≤ L.degSide) →
                                                          (degSide_le : L.degSide + 1 ≤ L.degCoef) →
                                                            (cellCorner_spec :
                                                                ∀ (i j : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                                  L.cellCorner i j = some c →
                                                                    L.corner c =
                                                                      (if i = 0 then K.r₁ else K.r₂,
                                                                        if j = 0 then K.z₁ else K.z₂)) →
                                                              (cellCorner_axis :
                                                                  ∀ (i j : Fin 2),
                                                                    L.cellCorner i j = none → i = 0 ∧ K.r₁ = 0) →
                                                                (sideSegments_spec :
                                                                    ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                      ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                        ((L.segment s).radial = true ↔ ↑e < 2) ∧
                                                                          (L.segment s).level =
                                                                            if ↑e = 0 then K.r₁
                                                                            else
                                                                              if ↑e = 1 then K.r₂
                                                                              else if ↑e = 2 then K.z₁ else K.z₂) →
                                                                  (sideSegments_cover :
                                                                      ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                        (↑e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                                                                          ∀ (u : ℝ),
                                                                            (if ↑e < 2 then K.z₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.z₂
                                                                              else K.r₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.r₂) →
                                                                              ∃ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                                (L.segment s).lo ≤ u ∧
                                                                                  u ≤ (L.segment s).hi) →
                                                                    (sideSegments_disjoint :
                                                                        ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                          ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                            ∀ s' ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                              s ≠ s' →
                                                                                (L.segment s).hi ≤ (L.segment s').lo ∨
                                                                                  (L.segment s').hi ≤
                                                                                    (L.segment s).lo) →
                                                                      (segments_on_sides :
                                                                          ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                                            ∃ e, s ∈ L.sideSegments e) →
                                                                        (segment_orthonormal :
                                                                            ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (d d' : ℕ),
                                                                              d ≤ L.degSide + 1 →
                                                                                d' ≤ L.degSide + 1 →
                                                                                  ∫ (u : ℝ) in
                                                                                      Set.Icc (L.segment s).lo
                                                                                        (L.segment s).hi,
                                                                                      (L.segment s).test d u *
                                                                                        (L.segment s).test d' u =
                                                                                    if d = d' then 1 else 0) →
                                                                          motive ⋯) →
                  motive t

declarations.type:

  {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} →
    {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
      {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} →
        {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases} →
          {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout} →
            {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L → Sort u} →
              (t : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L) →
                ((order_eq : L.order = c.order) →
                    (box_eq : L.box = K) →
                      (bases_eq : L.bases = B) →
                        (modes_eq : L.modes = S.resolved) →
                          (degCoef_eq : L.degCoef = S.degHigh) →
                            (degSide_eq : L.degSide = S.degLow) →
                              (box_valid : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBox K) →
                                (bases_valid : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBases K B) →
                                  (segment_valid :
                                      ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (L.segment s)) →
                                    (presSegment_valid :
                                        ∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (L.presSegment s)) →
                                      (gauge_valid :
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment L.gauge ∧
                                            L.gauge.testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ L.gauge.lo) →
                                        (segment_on_side :
                                            ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                              (L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                                  ((L.segment s).level = K.r₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.r₂) ∧
                                                    K.z₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧
                                                      (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.z₂ ∧ (L.segment s).level ≠ 0 ∨
                                                ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                                  ((L.segment s).level = K.z₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.z₂) ∧
                                                    K.r₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧ (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →
                                          (segment_other_in_box :
                                              ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                ((L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                    (L.segment s).other = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.segment s).level) ∧
                                                  (¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                    (L.segment s).other = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.segment s).level)) →
                                            (corner_is_corner :
                                                ∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                  ((L.corner c).1 = K.r₁ ∨ (L.corner c).1 = K.r₂) ∧
                                                    ((L.corner c).2 = K.z₁ ∨ (L.corner c).2 = K.z₂) ∧
                                                      (L.corner c).1 ≠ 0) →
                                              (corner_other :
                                                  ∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                    (L.cornerOther c).1 = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.corner c).1 ∧
                                                      (L.cornerOther c).2 = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.corner c).2) →
                                                (segEnd_spec :
                                                    ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                      L.segEnd s e = some c →
                                                        L.corner c =
                                                          if (L.segment s).radial = true then
                                                            ((L.segment s).level,
                                                              if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi)
                                                          else
                                                            (if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi,
                                                              (L.segment s).level)) →
                                                  (segEnd_axis :
                                                      ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2),
                                                        L.segEnd s e = none →
                                                          ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧ e = 0 ∧ (L.segment s).lo = 0) →
                                                    (radial_test_const :
                                                        ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                          (L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                            (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0) →
                                                      (height_test_affine :
                                                          ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                            ¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                              (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                                                                (L.segment s).testCoef 1 1 ≠ 0) →
                                                        (degSide_pos : 1 ≤ L.degSide) →
                                                          (degSide_le : L.degSide + 1 ≤ L.degCoef) →
                                                            (cellCorner_spec :
                                                                ∀ (i j : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                                  L.cellCorner i j = some c →
                                                                    L.corner c =
                                                                      (if i = 0 then K.r₁ else K.r₂,
                                                                        if j = 0 then K.z₁ else K.z₂)) →
                                                              (cellCorner_axis :
                                                                  ∀ (i j : Fin 2),
                                                                    L.cellCorner i j = none → i = 0 ∧ K.r₁ = 0) →
                                                                (sideSegments_spec :
                                                                    ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                      ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                        ((L.segment s).radial = true ↔ ↑e < 2) ∧
                                                                          (L.segment s).level =
                                                                            if ↑e = 0 then K.r₁
                                                                            else
                                                                              if ↑e = 1 then K.r₂
                                                                              else if ↑e = 2 then K.z₁ else K.z₂) →
                                                                  (sideSegments_cover :
                                                                      ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                        (↑e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                                                                          ∀ (u : ℝ),
                                                                            (if ↑e < 2 then K.z₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.z₂
                                                                              else K.r₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.r₂) →
                                                                              ∃ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                                (L.segment s).lo ≤ u ∧
                                                                                  u ≤ (L.segment s).hi) →
                                                                    (sideSegments_disjoint :
                                                                        ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                          ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                            ∀ s' ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                              s ≠ s' →
                                                                                (L.segment s).hi ≤ (L.segment s').lo ∨
                                                                                  (L.segment s').hi ≤
                                                                                    (L.segment s).lo) →
                                                                      (segments_on_sides :
                                                                          ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                                            ∃ e, s ∈ L.sideSegments e) →
                                                                        (segment_orthonormal :
                                                                            ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (d d' : ℕ),
                                                                              d ≤ L.degSide + 1 →
                                                                                d' ≤ L.degSide + 1 →
                                                                                  ∫ (u : ℝ) in
                                                                                      Set.Icc (L.segment s).lo
                                                                                        (L.segment s).hi,
                                                                                      (L.segment s).test d u *
                                                                                        (L.segment s).test d' u =
                                                                                    if d = d' then 1 else 0) →
                                                                          motive ⋯) →
                  motive t

declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N},
  0 ≤ c.innerWeight →
    c.innerWeight ≤ c.splitVisc →
      (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), √(c.cellWeight y) * ‖c.velocityError y‖ ≤ c.velocityLoss) →
        ∑ i, ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (c.actuatorGrad i y - c.modelActuatorGrad i y) ≤
            c.actuatorGradLoss ^ 2 →
          ∑ i, (c.rows fun y => c.actuator i y - c.modelActuator i y) ^ 2 ≤ c.actuatorLoss ^ 2 →
            ∑ i, ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (c.pin i y - c.modelPinField i y) ≤
                c.pinFieldLoss ^ 2 →
              0 ≤ c.centreLoss ∧
                  0 ≤ c.rateLoss ∧
                    0 ≤ c.strainLoss ∧
                      0 ≤ c.curlGradLoss ∧
                        0 ≤ c.velocityLoss ∧
                          0 ≤ c.curlLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.actuatorGradLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.actuatorLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.pinFieldLoss →
                c.centreLoss + (c.strainLoss + √(7 / 2) * c.curlGradLoss) / c.weightMin +
                      c.actuatorGradLoss / (2 * c.multiplierScale * √c.weightMin) ≤
                    c.potLoss →
                  √c.rowMax * c.centreLoss + c.rateLoss + (c.velocityLoss + c.curlLoss) / √c.weightMin +
                        c.actuatorLoss / c.multiplierScale ≤
                      c.rowLoss →
                    c.pinFieldLoss / √c.weightMin ≤ c.pinLoss →
                      (∀ (a b : Fin N), c.blockIndex a = c.blockIndex b → c.rowWeight a = c.rowWeight b) →
                        0 ≤ c.baseCoef →
                          (∀ (i : Fin c.levelCount), 0 ≤ c.levelCoef i) →
                            (∀ (i : Fin c.levelCount), 0 < c.levelRate i) →
                              c.splitVisc ^ (1 / (α - 1)) ≤ c.cutoff →
                                (∀ (x : ℝ), 0 < x → x ≤ c.cutoff → c.ratioSymbol α x ≤ c.levelSum x) →
                                  c.gapSymbol α c.cutoff ^ 2 / (c.gapSymbol α c.cutoff + c.reducedCoercivity) ≤
                                      c.levelSum c.cutoff →
                                    (∀ (a : Fin N),
                                        c.rowWeight a *
                                            (c.baseCoef +
                                                ∑ i, c.levelCoef i * c.spectralBound (c.blockIndex a) (c.levelRate i) +
                                              (α - 1) * c.tailConst * c.cutoff ^ (α - 1 - 1 / 2) / (1 / 2 - (α - 1))) ≤
                                          c.splitBound ^ 2) →
                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellNumbers α c

  S.resolved = Finset.Icc (-↑W.J) ↑W.J →
    S.band = Finset.Icc (-↑(W.J + W.JB)) ↑(W.J + W.JB) \ Finset.Icc (-↑W.J) ↑W.J →
      (∀ (n : ℤ), S.energyWeight n = W.energy) →
        (∀ (n : ℤ), S.vorticityWeight n = W.vorticity) →
          (∀ (n : ℤ), S.tailShift n = if n ∈ S.resolved then W.shift else 0) →
            (∀ (n : ℤ),
                S.curlAbsorb n =
                  if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedCurl else if n ∈ S.band then W.curlBand else W.curlOut) →
              (∀ (n : ℤ),
                  S.strainAbsorb n =
                    if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedStrain
                    else W.strainAt K S (W.kEff c.order n) (decide (n ∈ S.band))) →
                (∀ (n : ℤ), S.velocityAbsorb n = if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedVelocity else 0) →
                  (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                      S.symWeight n j l =

                                    K.angularWeight n *
                                      max (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n - 1) 0 ^ 2) -
                                2 * S.curlAbsorb n -
                              S.strainAbsorb n -
                            S.tailShift n) →
                      (∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),

                            (S.tailShift n *
                                if S.degHigh ≤ j then Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen K j
                                else Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen K l) -

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases}
  {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout},
  L.order = c.order →
    L.box = K →
      L.bases = B →
        L.modes = S.resolved →
          L.degCoef = S.degHigh →
            L.degSide = S.degLow →
              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBox K →
                Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBases K B →
                  (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount), Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (L.segment s)) →
                    (∀ (s : Fin L.presCount), Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (L.presSegment s)) →
                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment L.gauge ∧ L.gauge.testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ L.gauge.lo →
                        (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                            (L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                ((L.segment s).level = K.r₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.r₂) ∧
                                  K.z₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧ (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.z₂ ∧ (L.segment s).level ≠ 0 ∨
                              ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                ((L.segment s).level = K.z₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.z₂) ∧
                                  K.r₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧ (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →
                          (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                              ((L.segment s).radial = true → (L.segment s).other = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.segment s).level) ∧
                                (¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                  (L.segment s).other = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.segment s).level)) →
                            (∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                ((L.corner c).1 = K.r₁ ∨ (L.corner c).1 = K.r₂) ∧
                                  ((L.corner c).2 = K.z₁ ∨ (L.corner c).2 = K.z₂) ∧ (L.corner c).1 ≠ 0) →
                              (∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                  (L.cornerOther c).1 = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.corner c).1 ∧
                                    (L.cornerOther c).2 = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.corner c).2) →
                                (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                    L.segEnd s e = some c →
                                      L.corner c =
                                        if (L.segment s).radial = true then
                                          ((L.segment s).level, if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi)
                                        else
                                          (if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi, (L.segment s).level)) →
                                  (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2),
                                      L.segEnd s e = none →
                                        ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧ e = 0 ∧ (L.segment s).lo = 0) →
                                    (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                        (L.segment s).radial = true → (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0) →
                                      (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                          ¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                            (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧ (L.segment s).testCoef 1 1 ≠ 0) →
                                        1 ≤ L.degSide →
                                          L.degSide + 1 ≤ L.degCoef →
                                            (∀ (i j : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                L.cellCorner i j = some c →
                                                  L.corner c =
                                                    (if i = 0 then K.r₁ else K.r₂, if j = 0 then K.z₁ else K.z₂)) →
                                              (∀ (i j : Fin 2), L.cellCorner i j = none → i = 0 ∧ K.r₁ = 0) →
                                                (∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                    ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                      ((L.segment s).radial = true ↔ ↑e < 2) ∧
                                                        (L.segment s).level =
                                                          if ↑e = 0 then K.r₁
                                                          else if ↑e = 1 then K.r₂ else if ↑e = 2 then K.z₁ else K.z₂) →
                                                  (∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                      (↑e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                                                        ∀ (u : ℝ),
                                                          (if ↑e < 2 then K.z₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.z₂
                                                            else K.r₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.r₂) →
                                                            ∃ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                              (L.segment s).lo ≤ u ∧ u ≤ (L.segment s).hi) →
                                                    (∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                        ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                          ∀ s' ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                            s ≠ s' →
                                                              (L.segment s).hi ≤ (L.segment s').lo ∨
                                                                (L.segment s').hi ≤ (L.segment s).lo) →
                                                      (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount), ∃ e, s ∈ L.sideSegments e) →
                                                        (∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (d d' : ℕ),
                                                            d ≤ L.degSide + 1 →
                                                              d' ≤ L.degSide + 1 →
                                                                ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Icc (L.segment s).lo (L.segment s).hi,
                                                                    (L.segment s).test d u * (L.segment s).test d' u =
                                                                  if d = d' then 1 else 0) →
                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L

                                (M.coords K).layout.gauge.level ≠ 0 ∧

                    (gauge_canonical :

                          (M.coords K).gaugeLeft = M.canonicalLeft K ∧ (M.coords K).gaugeRight = M.canonicalRight K) →
                      (kappa_injective : Function.Injective Sp.kappaSlot) →

                            (delay_not_kappa : ∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (a : Fin k), M.delaySlot j ≠ Sp.kappaSlot a) →
                              (delay_unowned :
                                  ∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
                                    (r :

                                            (M.coords K).param).card),

                                (expansion_base : ∀ (i : Fin Sp.slots), ∀ p ∈ M.delayExpansion i, ¬M.IsDelaySlot p.1) →
                                  (expansion_consistent :
                                      ∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (l : Fin Sp.slots),
                                        ¬M.IsDelaySlot l →
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.rowEntries
                                              (M.delayExpansion (M.delaySlot j)) l =
                                            (List.map

                                                        (M.delayExpansion p.1) l

                                                              ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).other) →

                                                                ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).other) →

                                                          ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).1 ≠ 0 ∧
                                                            ((M.coords K).layout.cornerOther cr).1 ≠
                                                                ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).1 ∧
                                                              ((M.coords K).layout.cornerOther cr).2 ≠
                                                                  ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).2 ∧
                                                                0 ≤

                                                                    ((M.coords K).layout.cornerOther cr).1) →
                                                      (segments_valid :

                                                            (∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.segCount),
                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment
                                                                  ((M.coords K).layout.segment s)) ∧

                                                                  ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s)) →

                                                                  0 ≤ ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).lo) ∧
                                                                ∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.presCount),

                                                                              (M.classRootDatum cl) ≠

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsBaseSystem.casesOn
declarations.type:
{α : ℝ} →
  {k N : ℕ} →
    {d : Breakdown.SteadyCert.FracCertData k N} →
      {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsBaseSystem α d → Sort u} →
        (t : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsBaseSystem α d) →
          ((order_ge : 3 ≤ d.order) →
              (coercivity_pos : 0 < d.coercivity) →
                (coercivity_lt : d.coercivity < d.splitVisc) →
                  (pinWeight_pos : 0 < d.pinWeight) →
                    (rowMax_pos : 0 < d.rowMax) →
                      (multiplierScale_pos : 0 < d.multiplierScale) →
                        (radius_nonneg : ∀ (j : Fin k), 0 ≤ d.radius j) →
                          (slope_ne_zero : ∀ (j : Fin k), d.slope j ≠ 0) →
                            (ellipsoidRadius_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.ellipsoidRadius) →
                              (ellipsoid_le : ∀ j ∉ d.activeSet, d.ellipsoidRadius ≤ |d.slope j| * d.radius j) →
                                (frame_near :
                                    ∀ (z : Fin k → ℝ),
                                      |∑ j, d.frame.mulVec z j ^ 2 - ∑ j, z j ^ 2| ≤ d.frameDefect * ∑ j, z j ^ 2) →
                                  (frameDefect_lt : d.frameDefect < 1) →
                                    (pinGap_bound :
                                        ∑ l,
                                            ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                              Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (d.smoothPin l y - d.pin l y) ≤
                                          d.pinGap ^ 2) →
                                      (pinGap_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.pinGap) →
                                        (losses_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.potLoss ∧ 0 ≤ d.rowLoss ∧ 0 ≤ d.pinLoss) →
                                          (reduced_pos : 0 < d.reducedCoercivity) →
                                            (reduced_le : d.reducedCoercivity ≤ d.coercivity - d.potLoss) →
                                              (lowLoss_bound :
                                                  ∀ (κ₀ : ℝ),
                                                    0 < κ₀ →
                                                      max (d.splitVisc - κ₀ ^ (2 * (α - 1))) 0 ≤
                                                        d.lowLoss * (1 + d.weightMin / κ₀ ^ 2)) →
                                                (reducedGap_pos : 0 < d.reducedGap) →
                                                  (formScale_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.formScale) →
                                                    (formScale_bound :
                                                        ∀ (κ₀ : ℝ),
                                                          0 < κ₀ →
                                                            1 ≤
                                                              d.formScale ^ 2 *
                                                                (κ₀ ^ (2 * (α - 1)) - d.splitVisc +
                                                                  d.reducedCoercivity * (1 + d.weightMin / κ₀ ^ 2))) →
                                                      (splitBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.splitBound) →
                                                        (contraction_lt : d.contraction < 1) →
                                                          (productConst_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.productConst) →
                                                            (defect_norm :
                                                                ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                  Breakdown.SteadyCert.projectedNorm (d.defect α p) ≤
                                                                    d.defectBound) →
                                                              (defect_rows :
                                                                  ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                    d.rowsModGrad (d.defect α p) ≤ d.defectRowBound) →
                                                                (size_ge :
                                                                    d.boundFn d.defectBound d.defectRowBound 0 ≤
                                                                      d.sizeBound) →
                                                                  (size_small :
                                                                      4 * d.rowConst * d.productConst * d.sizeBound <
                                                                        1) →
                                                                    (adjointQuad_nonneg :
                                                                        ∀ j ∈ d.activeSet,
                                                                          ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                            0 ≤ d.adjointQuad j p) →
                                                                      (active_inclusion :
                                                                          ∀ j ∈ d.activeSet,
                                                                            ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                              ∀ p' ∈ d.testBox,
                                                                                d.adjointQuad j p * d.heldRadius ^ 2 +
                                                                                      d.heldRadius *
                                                                                        √((d.adjointLocal j p +
                                                                                                  d.adjointSpread j p +
                                                                                                Breakdown.SteadyCert.vecNorm
                                                                                                      (d.adjointPin j
                                                                                                        p) *
                                                                                                    d.pinGap /
                                                                                                  √d.weightMin) ^
                                                                                              2 +
                                                                                            Breakdown.SteadyCert.vecNorm
                                                                                                  (d.adjointError j p) ^
                                                                                                2 /
                                                                                              d.multiplierScale ^ 2) +
                                                                                    |d.adjustedMultiplier α p' j| ≤
                                                                                  |d.slope j| * d.radius j) →
                                                                        (stiff_inclusion :
                                                                            ∀ p' ∈ d.testBox,
                                                                              √(1 + d.frameDefect) * d.heldRadius /
                                                                                    d.multiplierScale +
                                                                                  √(∑ j ∈ d.activeSetᶜ,
                                                                                      (d.frame.transpose.mulVec
                                                                                            (d.multiplier p') j -
                                                                                          d.slope j * p' j) ^
                                                                                        2) ≤
                                                                                d.ellipsoidRadius) →
                                                                          (nontrivial :
                                                                              ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                                d.heldRadius / √d.weightMin <
                                                                                  √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                      Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq
                                                                                        (d.gradProfile p y))) →
                                                                            motive ⋯) →
            motive t

declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {Sp : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.CellSplit k N}
  {M : Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.MeshData k N Sp},
  (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount), Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsGaugeSpec (M.coords K).layout (M.coords K).gaugeSpec) →
    (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
        Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (M.coords K).layout.gauge ∧
          (M.coords K).layout.gauge.testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧
            0 ≤ (M.coords K).layout.gauge.lo ∧
              ((M.coords K).layout.gauge.radial = true →
                (M.coords K).layout.gauge.level ≠ 0 ∧
                  0 ≤ min (M.coords K).layout.gauge.level (M.coords K).layout.gauge.other)) →
      (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
          (M.coords K).gaugeLeft = M.canonicalLeft K ∧ (M.coords K).gaugeRight = M.canonicalRight K) →
        Function.Injective Sp.kappaSlot →
          (∀ (a : Fin k) (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
              (j :
                Fin
                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords (M.coords K).layout
                      (M.coords K).param).card),
              (M.coords K).Tmap j (Sp.kappaSlot a) = 0) →
            Function.Injective M.delaySlot →
              (∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (a : Fin k), M.delaySlot j ≠ Sp.kappaSlot a) →
                (∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
                    (r :
                      Fin
                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords (M.coords K).layout
                            (M.coords K).param).card),
                    (M.coords K).Tmap r (M.delaySlot j) = 0) →
                  (∀ (i : Fin Sp.slots), ∀ p ∈ M.delayExpansion i, ¬M.IsDelaySlot p.1) →
                    (∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (l : Fin Sp.slots),
                        ¬M.IsDelaySlot l →
                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.rowEntries (M.delayExpansion (M.delaySlot j)) l =
                            (List.map
                                (fun p =>
                                  p.2 *
                                    if M.IsDelaySlot p.1 then
                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.rowEntries (M.delayExpansion p.1) l
                                    else if p.1 = l then 1 else 0)
                                (M.delayRow j)).sum) →
                      (∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (i : Fin k),
                          Sp.freeMap (M.delaySlot j) i =
                            (List.map (fun p => p.2 * Sp.freeMap p.1 i) (M.delayRow j)).sum) →
                        (∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount),
                            Sp.delayForm j = Matrix.vecMulVec (M.delayVector j) (M.delayVector j)) →
                          (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
                              (j :
                                Fin
                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords (M.coords K).layout
                                      (M.coords K).param).card),
                              ∃ parts extra,
                                (∀ (i' : Fin Sp.slots),
                                    (M.coords K).Tmap j i' = Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.rowEntries parts i') ∧
                                  (∀ p ∈ parts, ∀ (a : Fin k), Sp.kappaSlot a ≠ p.1) ∧
                                    (∀ p ∈ parts, ¬M.IsDelaySlot p.1) ∧
                                      (∀ p ∈ parts,
                                          (M.rowDatum (M.ownerCell p.1) (M.ownerRow p.1)).2 = (M.rowDatum K j).2) ∧
                                        (∀ e ∈ extra, (M.coords e.fst).layout.IsGaugeDeleted e.snd.1) ∧
                                          ((extra = [] ∧
                                                ∃ i,
                                                  parts = [(i, 1)] ∧
                                                    M.rowKey K j = M.ownerKey i ∧
                                                      (M.rowKey K j =
                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.SkeletonKey.private_ →
                                                        M.ownerCell i = K ∧ M.ownerRow i ≍ j)) ∨
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.SegmentSplit (M.rowKey K j)
                                                  (List.map (fun p => (M.ownerKey p.1, p.2)) parts ++
                                                    M.extraKeys extra) ∨
                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.FluxSplit (M.rowKey K j)
                                                    (List.map (fun p => (M.ownerKey p.1, p.2)) parts ++
                                                      M.extraKeys extra) ∨
                                                  parts = [] ∧ extra = [] ∧ M.DeletedKey K j (M.rowKey K j)) ∧
                                            ∀ u ∈ M.participantNodes K j parts ++ M.extraNodes extra,
                                              ∀ v ∈ M.participantNodes K j parts ++ M.extraNodes extra,
                                                u.1 = v.1 → u.2 = v.2) →
                            (∀ (i : Fin Sp.slots),
                                (∀ (a : Fin k), Sp.kappaSlot a ≠ i) →
                                  ¬M.IsDelaySlot i →
                                    ∀ (i' : Fin Sp.slots),
                                      (M.coords (M.ownerCell i)).Tmap (M.ownerRow i) i' = if i' = i then 1 else 0) →
                              (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount), (M.coords K).layout.order = c.order) →
                                (∀ (K K' : Fin Sp.cellCount), (M.coords K).layout.gauge = (M.coords K').layout.gauge) →
                                  (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount) (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.segCount),
                                      ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).radial = true →
                                        ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).level ≠ 0 ∧
                                          0 ≤
                                            min ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).level
                                              ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).other) →
                                    (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount) (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.presCount),
                                        ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).radial = true →
                                          ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).level ≠ 0 ∧
                                            0 ≤
                                              min ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).level
                                                ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).other) →
                                      (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount) (cr : Fin (M.coords K).layout.cornerCount),
                                          ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).1 ≠ 0 ∧
                                            ((M.coords K).layout.cornerOther cr).1 ≠ ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).1 ∧
                                              ((M.coords K).layout.cornerOther cr).2 ≠
                                                  ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).2 ∧
                                                0 ≤
                                                  min ((M.coords K).layout.corner cr).1
                                                    ((M.coords K).layout.cornerOther cr).1) →
                                        (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                                            (∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.segCount),
                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment
                                                  ((M.coords K).layout.segment s)) ∧
                                              ∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.presCount),
                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment
                                                  ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s)) →
                                          (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                                              (∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.segCount),
                                                  0 ≤ ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).lo) ∧
                                                ∀ (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.presCount),
                                                  0 ≤ ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).lo) →
                                            (∀ (cl : Fin M.classCount),
                                                (M.classPath cl = [] ↔
                                                    M.nodeClass (M.classRoot cl) (M.classRootSide cl) = cl) ∧
                                                  M.classRootDatum cl ∈ (M.coords (M.classRoot cl)).gaugeSpec.roots ∧
                                                    (M.classRootSide cl = true →
                                                        (M.coords (M.classRoot cl)).layout.shiftCoefRight
                                                              (M.classRootDatum cl) ≠
                                                            0 ∧
                                                          (M.coords (M.classRoot cl)).layout.shiftCoefLeft
                                                              (M.classRootDatum cl) =
                                                            0) ∧
                                                      (M.classRootSide cl = false →
                                                        (M.coords (M.classRoot cl)).layout.shiftCoefLeft
                                                              (M.classRootDatum cl) ≠
                                                            0 ∧
                                                          (M.coords (M.classRoot cl)).layout.shiftCoefRight
                                                              (M.classRootDatum cl) =
                                                            0)) →
                                              (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                                                  ∀ r ∈ (M.coords K).gaugeSpec.roots,
                                                    ∃ cl,
                                                      ∃ (_ : M.classRoot cl = K),
                                                        M.classRootDatum cl ≍ r ∧ M.classPath cl = []) →
                                                (∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
                                                    (e :
                                                      Fin (M.coords K).layout.presCount ×
                                                        Fin (M.coords K).layout.degSide),
                                                    (M.coords K).gaugeSpec.edge = some e →
                                                      (M.classRoot (M.nodeClass K true) =
                                                            M.classRoot (M.nodeClass K false) ∧
                                                          M.classRootSide (M.nodeClass K true) =
                                                              M.classRootSide (M.nodeClass K false) ∧
                                                            M.classRootDatum (M.nodeClass K true) ≍
                                                              M.classRootDatum (M.nodeClass K false)) ∧
                                                        (M.classPath (M.nodeClass K true) =
                                                            M.classPath (M.nodeClass K false) ++ [(K, true)] ∨
                                                          M.classPath (M.nodeClass K false) =
                                                            M.classPath (M.nodeClass K true) ++ [(K, false)])) →
                                                  (∀ (K K' : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                                                      (M.coords K).layout.box.r₁ = 0 →
                                                        (M.coords K').layout.box.r₁ = 0 →
                                                          M.nodeClass K false = M.nodeClass K' false) →
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.IsMeshData α c Sp M

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases}
  {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout},
  Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L →
    (∀ n ∈ L.modes, -n ∈ L.modes) →
      (∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
          (L.presSegment s).radial = true ∧
              ((L.presSegment s).level = K.r₁ ∨ (L.presSegment s).level = K.r₂) ∧
                K.z₁ ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo ∧ (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ K.z₂ ∧ (L.presSegment s).level ≠ 0 ∨
            ¬(L.presSegment s).radial = true ∧
              ((L.presSegment s).level = K.z₁ ∨ (L.presSegment s).level = K.z₂) ∧
                K.r₁ ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo ∧ (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →
        (∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
            ((L.presSegment s).radial = true → (L.presSegment s).other = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.presSegment s).level) ∧
              (¬(L.presSegment s).radial = true → (L.presSegment s).other = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.presSegment s).level)) →
          (∀ (e : Fin 4),
              (↑e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                ∀ (u : ℝ),
                  (if ↑e < 2 then K.z₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.z₂ else K.r₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.r₂) →
                    ∃ s,
                      ((L.presSegment s).radial = true ↔ ↑e < 2) ∧
                        ((L.presSegment s).level =
                            if ↑e = 0 then K.r₁ else if ↑e = 1 then K.r₂ else if ↑e = 2 then K.z₁ else K.z₂) ∧
                          (L.presSegment s).lo ≤ u ∧ u ≤ (L.presSegment s).hi) →
            (∀ (s s' : Fin L.presCount),
                s ≠ s' →
                  (L.presSegment s).radial = (L.presSegment s').radial →
                    (L.presSegment s).level = (L.presSegment s').level →
                      (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ (L.presSegment s').lo ∨ (L.presSegment s').hi ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo) →
              (∀ (s : Fin L.presCount) (d d' : ℕ),
                  d < L.degSide →
                    d' < L.degSide →
                      ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Icc (L.presSegment s).lo (L.presSegment s).hi,
                          (L.presSegment s).test d u * (L.presSegment s).test d' u =
                        if d = d' then 1 else 0) →
                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout c K S B L
