declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsBaseSystem.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {d : Breakdown.SteadyCert.FracCertData k N},
  3 ≤ d.order →
    0 < d.coercivity →
      d.coercivity < d.splitVisc →
        0 < d.pinWeight →
          0 < d.rowMax →
            0 < d.multiplierScale →
              (∀ (j : Fin k), 0 ≤ d.radius j) →
                (∀ (j : Fin k), d.slope j ≠ 0) →
                  0 ≤ d.ellipsoidRadius →
                    (∀ j ∉ d.activeSet, d.ellipsoidRadius ≤ |d.slope j| * d.radius j) →
                      (∀ (z : Fin k → ℝ), |∑ j, d.frame.mulVec z j ^ 2 - ∑ j, z j ^ 2| ≤ d.frameDefect * ∑ j, z j ^ 2) →
                        d.frameDefect < 1 →
                          ∑ l, ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (d.smoothPin l y - d.pin l y) ≤
                              d.pinGap ^ 2 →
                            0 ≤ d.pinGap →
                              0 ≤ d.potLoss ∧ 0 ≤ d.rowLoss ∧ 0 ≤ d.pinLoss →
                                0 < d.reducedCoercivity →
                                  d.reducedCoercivity ≤ d.coercivity - d.potLoss →
                                    (∀ (κ₀ : ℝ),
                                        0 < κ₀ →
                                          max (d.splitVisc - κ₀ ^ (2 * (α - 1))) 0 ≤
                                            d.lowLoss * (1 + d.weightMin / κ₀ ^ 2)) →
                                      0 < d.reducedGap →
                                        0 ≤ d.formScale →
                                          (∀ (κ₀ : ℝ),
                                              0 < κ₀ →
                                                1 ≤
                                                  d.formScale ^ 2 *
                                                    (κ₀ ^ (2 * (α - 1)) - d.splitVisc +
                                                      d.reducedCoercivity * (1 + d.weightMin / κ₀ ^ 2))) →
                                            0 ≤ d.splitBound →
                                              d.contraction < 1 →
                                                0 ≤ d.productConst →
                                                  (∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                      Breakdown.SteadyCert.projectedNorm (d.defect α p) ≤
                                                        d.defectBound) →
                                                    (∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                        d.rowsModGrad (d.defect α p) ≤ d.defectRowBound) →
                                                      d.boundFn d.defectBound d.defectRowBound 0 ≤ d.sizeBound →
                                                        4 * d.rowConst * d.productConst * d.sizeBound < 1 →
                                                          (∀ j ∈ d.activeSet,
                                                              ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                0 ≤ d.adjointQuad j p) →
                                                            (∀ j ∈ d.activeSet,
                                                                ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                  ∀ p' ∈ d.testBox,
                                                                    d.adjointQuad j p * d.heldRadius ^ 2 +
                                                                          d.heldRadius *
                                                                            √((d.adjointLocal j p +
                                                                                      d.adjointSpread j p +
                                                                                    Breakdown.SteadyCert.vecNorm
                                                                                          (d.adjointPin j p) *
                                                                                        d.pinGap /
                                                                                      √d.weightMin) ^
                                                                                  2 +
                                                                                Breakdown.SteadyCert.vecNorm
                                                                                      (d.adjointError j p) ^
                                                                                    2 /
                                                                                  d.multiplierScale ^ 2) +
                                                                        |d.adjustedMultiplier α p' j| ≤
                                                                      |d.slope j| * d.radius j) →
                                                              (∀ p' ∈ d.testBox,
                                                                  √(1 + d.frameDefect) * d.heldRadius /
                                                                        d.multiplierScale +
                                                                      √(∑ j ∈ d.activeSetᶜ,
                                                                          (d.frame.transpose.mulVec (d.multiplier p')
                                                                                j -
                                                                              d.slope j * p' j) ^
                                                                            2) ≤
                                                                    d.ellipsoidRadius) →
                                                                (∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                    d.heldRadius / √d.weightMin <
                                                                      √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                          Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq
                                                                            (d.gradProfile p y))) →
                                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsBaseSystem α d

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightTests.rec
declarations.type:
{α : ℝ} →
  {k N : ℕ} →
    {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} →
      {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
        {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} →
          {W : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.WeightData} →
            {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightTests α c K S W → Sort u} →
              ((order_ge : 3 ≤ c.order) →
                  (energy_pos : 0 < W.energy) →
                    (energy_le : W.energy ≤ c.innerWeight - c.coercivity) →
                      (vorticity_nonneg : 0 ≤ W.vorticity) →
                        (vorticity_le : W.vorticity ≤ c.splitVisc - c.innerWeight) →
                          (shift_nonneg : 0 ≤ W.shift) →
                            (floor_pos : 0 < S.weightFloor) →
                              (range_pos : 0 ≤ W.rLo) →
                                (range_spec :
                                    ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                      p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                        W.rLo ≤ Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p ∧
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p ≤ W.rHi) →
                                  (mean_le :
                                      ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst * S.meanGradBound p ≤
                                          2 * W.meanConst) →
                                    (wave_le :
                                        ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst * S.waveGradBound p ≤
                                            2 * W.waveConst) →
                                      (lam_le : ∀ p ∈ K.rect, S.strainBound p ≤ W.lamMax) →
                                        (weight_le :
                                            ∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.sampleWeight c p ≤
                                                W.weightMax) →
                                          (splitLength_pos : 0 < S.splitLength) →
                                            (consts_nonneg : 0 ≤ W.meanConst ∧ 0 ≤ W.waveConst ∧ 0 ≤ c.coercivity) →
                                              (penalties_nonneg :
                                                  0 ≤ S.penaltyStrain ∧ 0 ≤ S.penaltyCurl ∧ 0 ≤ S.penaltyVelocity) →
                                                (curl_band_ge :
                                                    max (W.rLo * (W.lamMax - (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight)))
                                                        (W.rHi * (W.lamMax - (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight))) ≤
                                                      W.curlBand) →
                                                  (curl_out_ge :
                                                      max
                                                          (W.rLo *
                                                            (W.lamMax + S.penaltyCurl -
                                                              (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight)))
                                                          (W.rHi *
                                                            (W.lamMax + S.penaltyCurl -
                                                              (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight))) ≤
                                                        W.curlOut) →
                                                    (strain_base_ge :
                                                        max
                                                            (W.rLo *
                                                              (W.waveConst * S.splitLength -
                                                                (c.curlWeight - c.coercivity * W.weightMax)))
                                                            (W.rHi *
                                                              (W.waveConst * S.splitLength -
                                                                (c.curlWeight - c.coercivity * W.weightMax))) ≤
                                                          W.strainBase) →
                                                      (strain_quad_ge :
                                                          W.rHi * W.waveConst / S.splitLength ≤ W.strainQuad) →
                                                        (sym_resolved_radial :
                                                            S.weightFloor ≤
                                                              W.energy *
                                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                      K (S.degHigh + 1) 0 -
                                                                  W.resolvedStrain -
                                                                W.shift) →
                                                          (sym_resolved_height :
                                                              S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                W.energy *
                                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                        K 0 (S.degHigh + 1) -
                                                                    W.resolvedStrain -
                                                                  W.shift) →
                                                            (anti_resolved_radial :
                                                                S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                  (W.energy + 2 * W.vorticity) *
                                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                            K (S.degHigh + 1) 0 -
                                                                        2 * W.resolvedCurl -
                                                                      W.resolvedStrain -
                                                                    W.shift) →
                                                              (anti_resolved_height :
                                                                  S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                    (W.energy + 2 * W.vorticity) *
                                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                              K 0 (S.degHigh + 1) -
                                                                          2 * W.resolvedCurl -
                                                                        W.resolvedStrain -
                                                                      W.shift) →
                                                                (sym_band :
                                                                    S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                      W.symAt K S 0 0 (↑(W.J + 1) * ↑c.order) true) →
                                                                  (sym_out :
                                                                      S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                        W.symAt K S 0 0 (↑(W.J + W.JB + 1) * ↑c.order)
                                                                          false) →
                                                                    (anti_band :
                                                                        S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                          W.antiAt K S 0 0 (↑(W.J + 1) * ↑c.order)
                                                                            true) →
                                                                      (anti_out :
                                                                          S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                            W.antiAt K S 0 0
                                                                              (↑(W.J + W.JB + 1) * ↑c.order) false) →
                                                                        (vel_radial :
                                                                            S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                              W.shift *
                                                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen
                                                                                    K S.degHigh -
                                                                                W.resolvedVelocity) →
                                                                          (vel_height :
                                                                              S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                                W.shift *
                                                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen
                                                                                      K S.degHigh -
                                                                                  W.resolvedVelocity) →
                                                                            motive ⋯) →
                (t : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightTests α c K S W) → motive t

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsReducedLosses.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {D : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.ProfileData k}
  {A : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.AuxData k} {M : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.CellMesh}
  {RD : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.RowData M N} {X : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.CellSystemData k N M},
  (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), ‖c.strainError y‖ ≤ X.strainOpBound) →
    X.strainOpBound ≤ c.strainLoss →
      Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumBounded c.order (fun y => ‖c.curlGradError y‖ ^ 2) X.curlGradSums →
        Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumValues c.order X.curlGradSums →
          (∀ (a : Fin X.curlGradSums.boxCount), X.curlGradSums.boxBound a ≤ X.curlGradKernel) →
            √X.curlGradKernel ≤ c.curlGradLoss →
              Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumBounded c.order (fun y => c.cellWeight y * ‖c.curlError y‖ ^ 2)
                  X.curlSums →
                Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumValues c.order X.curlSums →
                  (∀ (a : Fin X.curlSums.boxCount), X.curlSums.boxBound a ≤ X.curlKernel) →
                    √X.curlKernel ≤ c.curlLoss →
                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsRowTurnNumbers c M RD X.rateRowConst →
                        (∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box c.radius,
                            |c.rotationRate p - c.modelRate| * (↑c.order / (↑c.order - 1)) * X.rateRowConst ≤
                              c.rateLoss * √c.weightMin) →
                          (∀ (i : Fin k) (β : ℝ),
                              |β - D.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                  ‖Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.ampField D X.splitStep i β y‖ ≤ X.ampSup i) →
                            (∀ μ ∈ D.index,
                                2 ≤ ∑ i, μ i →
                                  ∀ (β : ℝ),
                                    |β - D.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                      ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                        ‖Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.fieldOf D.chart (D.part μ) β y‖ ≤
                                          X.higherSup μ) →
                              (∀ (β : ℝ),
                                  |β - D.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                    ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                      ‖Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.phaseCurvField D.chart (D.part 0) β y‖ ≤
                                        X.curvSup) →
                                (∀ (p : Fin k → ℝ),
                                    X.centreSup p =
                                      ∑ i, c.radius i * X.ampSup i +
                                          ∑ μ ∈ D.index with 2 ≤ ∑ i, μ i, (∏ i, c.radius i ^ μ i) * X.higherSup μ +
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.splitWidth c.radius X.splitStep ^ 2 / 2 *
                                          X.curvSup) →
                                  (∀ (i : Fin k), X.splitStep i = -(2 * D.power * ↑D.chart.m * D.rateSlope i)) →
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.splitWidth c.radius X.splitStep ≤ X.splitRange →
                                      (∀ (i : Fin k), Pi.single i 1 ∈ D.index) →
                                        (∀ (i : Fin k) (β : ℝ),
                                            |β - D.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumBounded c.order
                                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.gradSq
                                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.ampField D X.splitStep i β))
                                                (X.ampSums i)) →
                                          (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumValues c.order (X.ampSums i)) →
                                            (∀ (i : Fin k) (a : Fin (X.ampSums i).boxCount),
                                                (X.ampSums i).boxBound a ≤ X.ampKernel i ^ 2) →
                                              (∀ μ ∈ D.index,
                                                  2 ≤ ∑ i, μ i →
                                                    ∀ (β : ℝ),
                                                      |β - D.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumBounded c.order
                                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.gradSq
                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.fieldOf D.chart (D.part μ)
                                                              β))
                                                          (X.higherSums μ)) →
                                                (∀ μ ∈ D.index,
                                                    2 ≤ ∑ i, μ i →
                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumValues c.order
                                                        (X.higherSums μ)) →
                                                  (∀ μ ∈ D.index,
                                                      2 ≤ ∑ i, μ i →
                                                        ∀ (a : Fin (X.higherSums μ).boxCount),
                                                          (X.higherSums μ).boxBound a ≤ X.higherKernel μ ^ 2) →
                                                    (∀ (β : ℝ),
                                                        |β - D.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumBounded c.order
                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.gradSq
                                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.phaseCurvField D.chart
                                                                (D.part 0) β))
                                                            X.curvSums) →
                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumValues c.order X.curvSums →
                                                        (∀ (a : Fin X.curvSums.boxCount),
                                                            X.curvSums.boxBound a ≤ X.curvKernel ^ 2) →
                                                          (∀ (i : Fin k), 0 ≤ X.ampKernel i) ∧
                                                              (∀ (μ : Fin k → ℕ), 0 ≤ X.higherKernel μ) ∧
                                                                0 ≤ X.curvKernel →
                                                            ∑ i, c.radius i * X.ampKernel i +
                                                                    ∑ μ ∈ D.index with 2 ≤ ∑ i, μ i,
                                                                      (∏ i, c.radius i ^ μ i) * X.higherKernel μ +
                                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.splitWidth c.radius
                                                                          X.splitStep ^
                                                                        2 /
                                                                      2 *
                                                                    X.curvKernel ≤
                                                                X.centreKernel →
                                                              0 ≤ X.centreKernel →
                                                                (∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box c.radius,
                                                                    X.centreSup p + X.centreKernel ≤
                                                                      c.centreLoss * √c.weightMin) →
                                                                  (2 * Real.pi) ^ (-1 / 2) * (27 / 256) ^ (1 / 4) *
                                                                        c.weightMin ^ (-3 / 4) ≤
                                                                      c.productConst →
                                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.splitWidth c.radius
                                                                          A.phaseSlope ≤
                                                                        X.splitRange →
                                                                      (∀ j ∈ c.activeSet,
                                                                          ∀ γ ∈ (A.adjointFamily j).indices,
                                                                            ∀ (β : ℝ),
                                                                              |β - A.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumBounded
                                                                                  c.order (fun y => ⋯ / X.weightValue)
                                                                                  (X.adjointSums j γ)) →
                                                                        (∀ j ∈ c.activeSet,
                                                                            ∀ γ ∈ (A.adjointFamily j).indices,
                                                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumValues
                                                                                c.order (X.adjointSums j γ)) →
                                                                          (∀ j ∈ c.activeSet,
                                                                              ∀ γ ∈ (A.adjointFamily j).indices,
                                                                                ∀
                                                                                  (a :
                                                                                    Fin (X.adjointSums j γ).boxCount),
                                                                                  (X.adjointSums j γ).boxBound a ≤
                                                                                    X.adjointPartKernel j γ ^ 2) →

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsBaseSystem.rec
declarations.type:
{α : ℝ} →
  {k N : ℕ} →
    {d : Breakdown.SteadyCert.FracCertData k N} →
      {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsBaseSystem α d → Sort u} →
        ((order_ge : 3 ≤ d.order) →
            (coercivity_pos : 0 < d.coercivity) →
              (coercivity_lt : d.coercivity < d.splitVisc) →
                (pinWeight_pos : 0 < d.pinWeight) →
                  (rowMax_pos : 0 < d.rowMax) →
                    (multiplierScale_pos : 0 < d.multiplierScale) →
                      (radius_nonneg : ∀ (j : Fin k), 0 ≤ d.radius j) →
                        (slope_ne_zero : ∀ (j : Fin k), d.slope j ≠ 0) →
                          (ellipsoidRadius_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.ellipsoidRadius) →
                            (ellipsoid_le : ∀ j ∉ d.activeSet, d.ellipsoidRadius ≤ |d.slope j| * d.radius j) →
                              (frame_near :
                                  ∀ (z : Fin k → ℝ),
                                    |∑ j, d.frame.mulVec z j ^ 2 - ∑ j, z j ^ 2| ≤ d.frameDefect * ∑ j, z j ^ 2) →
                                (frameDefect_lt : d.frameDefect < 1) →
                                  (pinGap_bound :
                                      ∑ l,
                                          ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                            Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (d.smoothPin l y - d.pin l y) ≤
                                        d.pinGap ^ 2) →
                                    (pinGap_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.pinGap) →
                                      (losses_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.potLoss ∧ 0 ≤ d.rowLoss ∧ 0 ≤ d.pinLoss) →
                                        (reduced_pos : 0 < d.reducedCoercivity) →
                                          (reduced_le : d.reducedCoercivity ≤ d.coercivity - d.potLoss) →
                                            (lowLoss_bound :
                                                ∀ (κ₀ : ℝ),
                                                  0 < κ₀ →
                                                    max (d.splitVisc - κ₀ ^ (2 * (α - 1))) 0 ≤
                                                      d.lowLoss * (1 + d.weightMin / κ₀ ^ 2)) →
                                              (reducedGap_pos : 0 < d.reducedGap) →
                                                (formScale_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.formScale) →
                                                  (formScale_bound :
                                                      ∀ (κ₀ : ℝ),
                                                        0 < κ₀ →
                                                          1 ≤
                                                            d.formScale ^ 2 *
                                                              (κ₀ ^ (2 * (α - 1)) - d.splitVisc +
                                                                d.reducedCoercivity * (1 + d.weightMin / κ₀ ^ 2))) →
                                                    (splitBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.splitBound) →
                                                      (contraction_lt : d.contraction < 1) →
                                                        (productConst_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.productConst) →
                                                          (defect_norm :
                                                              ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                Breakdown.SteadyCert.projectedNorm (d.defect α p) ≤
                                                                  d.defectBound) →
                                                            (defect_rows :
                                                                ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                  d.rowsModGrad (d.defect α p) ≤ d.defectRowBound) →
                                                              (size_ge :
                                                                  d.boundFn d.defectBound d.defectRowBound 0 ≤
                                                                    d.sizeBound) →
                                                                (size_small :
                                                                    4 * d.rowConst * d.productConst * d.sizeBound < 1) →
                                                                  (adjointQuad_nonneg :
                                                                      ∀ j ∈ d.activeSet,
                                                                        ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                          0 ≤ d.adjointQuad j p) →
                                                                    (active_inclusion :
                                                                        ∀ j ∈ d.activeSet,
                                                                          ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                            ∀ p' ∈ d.testBox,
                                                                              d.adjointQuad j p * d.heldRadius ^ 2 +
                                                                                    d.heldRadius *
                                                                                      √((d.adjointLocal j p +
                                                                                                d.adjointSpread j p +
                                                                                              Breakdown.SteadyCert.vecNorm
                                                                                                    (d.adjointPin j p) *
                                                                                                  d.pinGap /
                                                                                                √d.weightMin) ^
                                                                                            2 +
                                                                                          Breakdown.SteadyCert.vecNorm
                                                                                                (d.adjointError j p) ^
                                                                                              2 /
                                                                                            d.multiplierScale ^ 2) +
                                                                                  |d.adjustedMultiplier α p' j| ≤
                                                                                |d.slope j| * d.radius j) →
                                                                      (stiff_inclusion :
                                                                          ∀ p' ∈ d.testBox,
                                                                            √(1 + d.frameDefect) * d.heldRadius /
                                                                                  d.multiplierScale +
                                                                                √(∑ j ∈ d.activeSetᶜ,
                                                                                    (d.frame.transpose.mulVec
                                                                                          (d.multiplier p') j -
                                                                                        d.slope j * p' j) ^
                                                                                      2) ≤
                                                                              d.ellipsoidRadius) →
                                                                        (nontrivial :
                                                                            ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                              d.heldRadius / √d.weightMin <
                                                                                √(∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                                                                    Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq
                                                                                      (d.gradProfile p y))) →
                                                                          motive ⋯) →
          (t : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsBaseSystem α d) → motive t

                                  K.r₁ ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo ∧ (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →

Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsReducedLosses.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {D : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.ProfileData k}
  {A : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.AuxData k} {M : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.CellMesh}
  {RD : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.RowData M N} {X : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.CellSystemData k N M},
  (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), ‖c.strainError y‖ ≤ X.strainOpBound) →
    X.strainOpBound ≤ c.strainLoss →
      Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumBounded c.order (fun y => ‖c.curlGradError y‖ ^ 2) X.curlGradSums →
        Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumValues c.order X.curlGradSums →
          (∀ (a : Fin X.curlGradSums.boxCount), X.curlGradSums.boxBound a ≤ X.curlGradKernel) →
            √X.curlGradKernel ≤ c.curlGradLoss →
              Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumBounded c.order (fun y => c.cellWeight y * ‖c.curlError y‖ ^ 2)
                  X.curlSums →
                Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumValues c.order X.curlSums →
                  (∀ (a : Fin X.curlSums.boxCount), X.curlSums.boxBound a ≤ X.curlKernel) →
                    √X.curlKernel ≤ c.curlLoss →
                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsRowTurnNumbers c M RD X.rateRowConst →
                        (∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box c.radius,
                            |c.rotationRate p - c.modelRate| * (↑c.order / (↑c.order - 1)) * X.rateRowConst ≤
                              c.rateLoss * √c.weightMin) →
                          (∀ (i : Fin k) (β : ℝ),
                              |β - D.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                  ‖Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.ampField D X.splitStep i β y‖ ≤ X.ampSup i) →
                            (∀ μ ∈ D.index,
                                2 ≤ ∑ i, μ i →
                                  ∀ (β : ℝ),
                                    |β - D.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                      ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                        ‖Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.fieldOf D.chart (D.part μ) β y‖ ≤
                                          X.higherSup μ) →
                              (∀ (β : ℝ),
                                  |β - D.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                    ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                      ‖Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.phaseCurvField D.chart (D.part 0) β y‖ ≤
                                        X.curvSup) →
                                (∀ (p : Fin k → ℝ),
                                    X.centreSup p =
                                      ∑ i, c.radius i * X.ampSup i +
                                          ∑ μ ∈ D.index with 2 ≤ ∑ i, μ i, (∏ i, c.radius i ^ μ i) * X.higherSup μ +
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.splitWidth c.radius X.splitStep ^ 2 / 2 *
                                          X.curvSup) →
                                  (∀ (i : Fin k), X.splitStep i = -(2 * D.power * ↑D.chart.m * D.rateSlope i)) →
                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.splitWidth c.radius X.splitStep ≤ X.splitRange →
                                      (∀ (i : Fin k), Pi.single i 1 ∈ D.index) →
                                        (∀ (i : Fin k) (β : ℝ),
                                            |β - D.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumBounded c.order
                                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.gradSq
                                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.ampField D X.splitStep i β))
                                                (X.ampSums i)) →
                                          (∀ (i : Fin k),
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumValues c.order (X.ampSums i)) →
                                            (∀ (i : Fin k) (a : Fin (X.ampSums i).boxCount),
                                                (X.ampSums i).boxBound a ≤ X.ampKernel i ^ 2) →
                                              (∀ μ ∈ D.index,
                                                  2 ≤ ∑ i, μ i →
                                                    ∀ (β : ℝ),
                                                      |β - D.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumBounded c.order
                                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.gradSq
                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.fieldOf D.chart (D.part μ)
                                                              β))
                                                          (X.higherSums μ)) →
                                                (∀ μ ∈ D.index,
                                                    2 ≤ ∑ i, μ i →
                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumValues c.order
                                                        (X.higherSums μ)) →
                                                  (∀ μ ∈ D.index,
                                                      2 ≤ ∑ i, μ i →
                                                        ∀ (a : Fin (X.higherSums μ).boxCount),
                                                          (X.higherSums μ).boxBound a ≤ X.higherKernel μ ^ 2) →
                                                    (∀ (β : ℝ),
                                                        |β - D.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumBounded c.order
                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.gradSq
                                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.phaseCurvField D.chart
                                                                (D.part 0) β))
                                                            X.curvSums) →
                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumValues c.order X.curvSums →
                                                        (∀ (a : Fin X.curvSums.boxCount),
                                                            X.curvSums.boxBound a ≤ X.curvKernel ^ 2) →
                                                          (∀ (i : Fin k), 0 ≤ X.ampKernel i) ∧
                                                              (∀ (μ : Fin k → ℕ), 0 ≤ X.higherKernel μ) ∧
                                                                0 ≤ X.curvKernel →
                                                            ∑ i, c.radius i * X.ampKernel i +
                                                                    ∑ μ ∈ D.index with 2 ≤ ∑ i, μ i,
                                                                      (∏ i, c.radius i ^ μ i) * X.higherKernel μ +
                                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.splitWidth c.radius
                                                                          X.splitStep ^
                                                                        2 /
                                                                      2 *
                                                                    X.curvKernel ≤
                                                                X.centreKernel →
                                                              0 ≤ X.centreKernel →
                                                                (∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box c.radius,
                                                                    X.centreSup p + X.centreKernel ≤
                                                                      c.centreLoss * √c.weightMin) →
                                                                  (2 * Real.pi) ^ (-1 / 2) * (27 / 256) ^ (1 / 4) *
                                                                        c.weightMin ^ (-3 / 4) ≤
                                                                      c.productConst →
                                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.splitWidth c.radius
                                                                          A.phaseSlope ≤
                                                                        X.splitRange →
                                                                      (∀ j ∈ c.activeSet,
                                                                          ∀ γ ∈ (A.adjointFamily j).indices,
                                                                            ∀ (β : ℝ),
                                                                              |β - A.phase 0| ≤ X.splitRange →
                                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumBounded
                                                                                  c.order (fun y => ⋯ / X.weightValue)
                                                                                  (X.adjointSums j γ)) →
                                                                        (∀ j ∈ c.activeSet,
                                                                            ∀ γ ∈ (A.adjointFamily j).indices,
                                                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSumValues
                                                                                c.order (X.adjointSums j γ)) →
                                                                          (∀ j ∈ c.activeSet,
                                                                              ∀ γ ∈ (A.adjointFamily j).indices,
                                                                                ∀
                                                                                  (a :
                                                                                    Fin (X.adjointSums j γ).boxCount),
                                                                                  (X.adjointSums j γ).boxBound a ≤
                                                                                    X.adjointPartKernel j γ ^ 2) →
                                                                            (∀ (j : Fin k) (γ : Fin k → ℕ),
                                                                                0 ≤ X.adjointPartKernel j γ) →
                                                                              (∀ j ∈ c.activeSet,
                                                                                  ∑ γ ∈ (A.adjointFamily j).indices,
                                                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.GivenFields.multiPow
                                                                                          γ c.radius *
                                                                                        X.adjointPartKernel j γ ≤
                                                                                    √(X.adjointKernel j)) →
                                                                                (∀ (j : Fin k), 0 ≤ X.adjointKernel j) →
                                                                                  (∀ j ∈ c.activeSet,
                                                                                      ∀
                                                                                        p ∈
                                                                                          Breakdown.SteadyCert.box
                                                                                            c.radius,
                                                                                        √(X.adjointKernel j) /
                                                                                            √c.weightMin ≤
                                                                                          c.adjointQuad j p) →
                                                                                    (∀ j ∈ c.activeSet, ⋯) →
                                                                                      (∀ (j : Fin k), ⋯) →
                                                                                        ⋯ →
                                                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsReducedLosses
                                                                                            c D A M RD X

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm.recOn
declarations.type:
{k N : ℕ} →
  {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} →
    {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
      {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} →
        {W : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.WeightData} →
          {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm c K S W → Sort u} →
            (t : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm c K S W) →
              ((resolved_eq : S.resolved = Finset.Icc (-↑W.J) ↑W.J) →
                  (band_eq : S.band = Finset.Icc (-↑(W.J + W.JB)) ↑(W.J + W.JB) \ Finset.Icc (-↑W.J) ↑W.J) →
                    (energy_form : ∀ (n : ℤ), S.energyWeight n = W.energy) →
                      (vorticity_form : ∀ (n : ℤ), S.vorticityWeight n = W.vorticity) →
                        (shift_form : ∀ (n : ℤ), S.tailShift n = if n ∈ S.resolved then W.shift else 0) →
                          (curl_form :
                              ∀ (n : ℤ),
                                S.curlAbsorb n =
                                  if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedCurl
                                  else if n ∈ S.band then W.curlBand else W.curlOut) →
                            (strain_form :
                                ∀ (n : ℤ),
                                  S.strainAbsorb n =
                                    if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedStrain
                                    else W.strainAt K S (W.kEff c.order n) (decide (n ∈ S.band))) →
                              (velocity_form :
                                  ∀ (n : ℤ), S.velocityAbsorb n = if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedVelocity else 0) →
                                (sym_form :
                                    ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                      S.symWeight n j l =
                                        S.energyWeight n *
                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K j l +
                                                K.angularWeight n *
                                                  max (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n - 2) 0 ^
                                                    2) -
                                            S.strainAbsorb n -
                                          S.tailShift n) →
                                  (anti_form :
                                      ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                        S.antiWeight n j l =
                                          (S.energyWeight n + 2 * S.vorticityWeight n) *
                                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K j l +
                                                    K.angularWeight n *
                                                      max (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n - 1) 0 ^
                                                        2) -
                                                2 * S.curlAbsorb n -
                                              S.strainAbsorb n -
                                            S.tailShift n) →
                                    (vel_form :
                                        ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                          S.velWeight n j l =
                                            (S.tailShift n *
                                                if S.degHigh ≤ j then Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen K j
                                                else Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen K l) -
                                              S.velocityAbsorb n) →
                                      motive ⋯) →
                motive t

  [inst : Fintype I] [inst_1 : Fintype O] {T : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.TailFamily I O},
  (∀ (o : O), 0 ≤ T.outWeight o) →
    (∀ (i : I) (j : ℕ), 0 ≤ T.radialBound i j) →
      (∀ (i : I) (l : ℕ), 0 ≤ T.heightBound i l) →
        (∀ (i : I) (o : O) (c : Fin (T.dim i)),
            ∀ z ∈ Set.Icc K.z₁ K.z₂,
              ∀ (θ : ℝ),
                MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun r => T.mult i o c (r, z) θ)
                  (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc K.r₁ K.r₂))) →
          (∀ (i : I) (o : O) (c : Fin (T.dim i)),
              ∀ r ∈ Set.Icc K.r₁ K.r₂,
                ∀ (θ : ℝ),
                  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z => T.mult i o c (r, z) θ)
                    (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Icc K.z₁ K.z₂))) →
            (∀ (i : I),
                ∀ j ≤ T.inputDeg i,
                  ∀ z ∈ Set.Ioo K.z₁ K.z₂,
                    ∀ (θ : ℝ),
                      (∑ o,
                          T.outWeight o * ∑ c, K.radialTail B D fun r => T.mult i o c (r, z) θ * ↑(B.radialPoly j r)) ≤
                        T.radialBound i j ^ 2) →
              (∀ (i : I),
                  ∀ l ≤ T.inputDeg i,
                    ∀ r ∈ Set.Ioo K.r₁ K.r₂,
                      ∀ (θ : ℝ),
                        (∑ o,

                          T.heightBound i l ^ 2) →

declarations.type:
{α : ℝ} →
  {k N : ℕ} →
    {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} →
      {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellNumbers α c → Sort u} →
        ((innerWeight_nonneg : 0 ≤ c.innerWeight) →
            (innerWeight_le : c.innerWeight ≤ c.splitVisc) →
              (velocityLoss_bound : ∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), √(c.cellWeight y) * ‖c.velocityError y‖ ≤ c.velocityLoss) →
                (actuatorGradLoss_bound :
                    ∑ i,
                        ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                          Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (c.actuatorGrad i y - c.modelActuatorGrad i y) ≤
                      c.actuatorGradLoss ^ 2) →
                  (actuatorLoss_bound :
                      ∑ i, (c.rows fun y => c.actuator i y - c.modelActuator i y) ^ 2 ≤ c.actuatorLoss ^ 2) →
                    (pinFieldLoss_bound :
                        ∑ i, ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (c.pin i y - c.modelPinField i y) ≤
                          c.pinFieldLoss ^ 2) →
                      (losses_nonneg' :
                          0 ≤ c.centreLoss ∧
                            0 ≤ c.rateLoss ∧
                              0 ≤ c.strainLoss ∧
                                0 ≤ c.curlGradLoss ∧
                                  0 ≤ c.velocityLoss ∧
                                    0 ≤ c.curlLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.actuatorGradLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.actuatorLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.pinFieldLoss) →
                        (potLoss_ge :
                            c.centreLoss + (c.strainLoss + √(7 / 2) * c.curlGradLoss) / c.weightMin +
                                c.actuatorGradLoss / (2 * c.multiplierScale * √c.weightMin) ≤
                              c.potLoss) →
                          (rowLoss_ge :
                              √c.rowMax * c.centreLoss + c.rateLoss + (c.velocityLoss + c.curlLoss) / √c.weightMin +
                                  c.actuatorLoss / c.multiplierScale ≤
                                c.rowLoss) →
                            (pinLoss_ge : c.pinFieldLoss / √c.weightMin ≤ c.pinLoss) →
                              (rowWeight_block :
                                  ∀ (a b : Fin N), c.blockIndex a = c.blockIndex b → c.rowWeight a = c.rowWeight b) →
                                (baseCoef_nonneg : 0 ≤ c.baseCoef) →
                                  (levelCoef_nonneg : ∀ (i : Fin c.levelCount), 0 ≤ c.levelCoef i) →
                                    (levelRate_pos : ∀ (i : Fin c.levelCount), 0 < c.levelRate i) →
                                      (cutoff_ge : c.splitVisc ^ (1 / (α - 1)) ≤ c.cutoff) →
                                        (symbol_fit :
                                            ∀ (x : ℝ), 0 < x → x ≤ c.cutoff → c.ratioSymbol α x ≤ c.levelSum x) →
                                          (symbol_end :
                                              c.gapSymbol α c.cutoff ^ 2 /
                                                  (c.gapSymbol α c.cutoff + c.reducedCoercivity) ≤
                                                c.levelSum c.cutoff) →
                                            (splitBound_ge :
                                                ∀ (a : Fin N),
                                                  c.rowWeight a *
                                                      (c.baseCoef +
                                                          ∑ i,
                                                            c.levelCoef i *
                                                              c.spectralBound (c.blockIndex a) (c.levelRate i) +
                                                        (α - 1) * c.tailConst * c.cutoff ^ (α - 1 - 1 / 2) /
                                                          (1 / 2 - (α - 1))) ≤
                                                    c.splitBound ^ 2) →
                                              motive ⋯) →
          (t : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellNumbers α c) → motive t

                                                              ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).other) →

                                                                ((M.coords K).layout.presSegment s).other) →

                                                                              (M.classRootDatum cl) ≠

                                                                                    (M.classRoot

                                                                              (M.classRootDatum cl) =

                X.exterior.coefLower ≤ Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.ExteriorData.gradientCoef c X.exterior α y) →
              (∀ y ∉ c.cellRegion,
                  ‖y‖ ^ 2 *
                      (Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst / 2 * X.exterior.waveCurlGradBound y /
                        X.exterior.splitLength y) ≤
                    X.exterior.weightedWave) →
                (∀ y ∉ c.cellRegion,
                    ‖y‖ * (Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst * X.exterior.meanCurlGradBound y) ≤
                      X.exterior.weightedMean) →
                  4 * X.exterior.weightedWave + 2 * X.exterior.weightedMean ≤ X.exterior.coefLower →

  {M : Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.MeshData k N Sp},
  Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.IsMeshData α c Sp M →
    ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
      (j : Fin (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords (M.coords K).layout (M.coords K).param).card),
      ∃ parts extra,
        (∀ (i' : Fin Sp.slots), (M.coords K).Tmap j i' = Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.rowEntries parts i') ∧
          (∀ p ∈ parts, ∀ (a : Fin k), Sp.kappaSlot a ≠ p.1) ∧
            (∀ p ∈ parts, ¬M.IsDelaySlot p.1) ∧
              (∀ p ∈ parts, (M.rowDatum (M.ownerCell p.1) (M.ownerRow p.1)).2 = (M.rowDatum K j).2) ∧
                (∀ e ∈ extra, (M.coords e.fst).layout.IsGaugeDeleted e.snd.1) ∧
                  ((extra = [] ∧
                        ∃ i,
                          parts = [(i, 1)] ∧
                            M.rowKey K j = M.ownerKey i ∧
                              (M.rowKey K j = Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.SkeletonKey.private_ →
                                M.ownerCell i = K ∧ M.ownerRow i ≍ j)) ∨
                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.SegmentSplit (M.rowKey K j)
                          (List.map (fun p => (M.ownerKey p.1, p.2)) parts ++ M.extraKeys extra) ∨
                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.FluxSplit (M.rowKey K j)
                            (List.map (fun p => (M.ownerKey p.1, p.2)) parts ++ M.extraKeys extra) ∨
                          parts = [] ∧ extra = [] ∧ M.DeletedKey K j (M.rowKey K j)) ∧

  {rowMax : ℝ},
  R.testPairing.PosDef →
    (∀ (a : Fin N),
        Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.IsSolenoidalProfile (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.azimuth m ↑(R.harmonic a))
          (R.profile a)) →

          (∀ (a : Fin N), (M.box (R.cell a)).r₁ = 0 → R.harmonic a = 0) →
            (∀ (a : Fin N),
                (M.box (R.cell a)).r₁ = 0 → ∀ (l : Fin (R.degree + 1)), R.profile a 0 0 l = 0 ∧ R.profile a 1 0 l = 0) →
              (∀ (a : Fin N) (j : Fin (R.degree + 1)),
                  R.profile a 0 j (Fin.last R.degree) = 0 ∧ R.profile a 2 (Fin.last R.degree) j = 0) →
                (∀ (a : Fin N), R.partner (R.partner a) = a) →
                  (∀ (a : Fin N), R.cell (R.partner a) = R.cell a) →
                    (∀ (a : Fin N), R.harmonic (R.partner a) = R.harmonic a) →
                      (∀ (a : Fin N), R.harmonic a = 0 → R.partner a = a) →
                        (∀ (a : Fin N), R.harmonic a ≠ 0 → R.positive (R.partner a) = !R.positive a) →
                          (∀ (a : Fin N),
                              R.harmonic a ≠ 0 →
                                R.positive a = true →
                                  ∀ (c : Fin 3) (j l : Fin (R.degree + 1)),

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSystemFacts.mk
declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {M : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.CellMesh}
  {MD : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.ModelData M k} {RD : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.RowData M N}
  {Sp : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.CellSplit k N} {K₂ : Fin Sp.cellCount}
  {r : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.CellEntry M N k Sp.slots}
  {C : Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.CellCoords k Sp.slots},
  Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.IsRowsInstance c M RD r.meshCell r.rows →
    Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm c r.box r.scalars r.weights →
      (∀ n ∉ r.scalars.resolved, ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), r.scalars.localMatrix n p = 0) →
        Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsResolvedTests α c r.scalars r.weights r.strainScalar r.lowConst →
          (r.scalars.strainBound = fun x => r.strainConst) →
            (r.scalars.meanGradBound = fun x => r.meanConst) →
              (r.scalars.waveGradBound = fun x => r.waveConst) →
                (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                    r.classes.strainDev i p =
                        r.devConst 0 i + r.devSlope 0 i * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat r.box p ∧
                      r.classes.gradDev i p =
                          r.devConst 1 i + r.devSlope 1 i * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat r.box p ∧
                        r.classes.velocityDev i p =
                            r.devConst 2 i + r.devSlope 2 i * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat r.box p ∧
                          r.classes.curlDev i p =
                            r.devConst 3 i +
                              r.devSlope 3 i * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat r.box p) →
                  Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightTests α c r.box r.scalars r.weights →
                    (r.box.IsAxis → r.weights.J = 0) →
                      3 ≤ r.scalars.degLow ∧
                          r.scalars.degLow + 2 ≤ r.scalars.degHigh ∧ r.scalars.degHigh + 1 ≤ r.scalars.degNear →
                        RD.degree + 2 ≤ r.scalars.degHigh →
                          MD.columnDegree + 1 ≤ r.scalars.degNear →
                            RD.degree + MD.degree + 2 ≤ r.rowDegree →
                              0 ≤ r.meanConst ∧ 0 ≤ r.waveConst →
                                Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsGivenBases r.box r.baseDegree r.givenBases →
                                  (∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo r.box.r₁ r.box.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo r.box.z₁ r.box.z₂,
                                      p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                        ∀ (θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
                                          inner ℝ
                                              ((c.modelStrain (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2)) u)
                                              u ≤
                                            r.strainConst * ‖u‖ ^ 2) →
                                    (∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo r.box.r₁ r.box.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo r.box.z₁ r.box.z₂,
                                        p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.OpBound
                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order 0 c.modelCurlGrad p.1 p.2)
                                            r.meanConst) →
                                      (∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo r.box.r₁ r.box.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo r.box.z₁ r.box.z₂,
                                          p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                            ∀ (θ : ℝ),
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.OpBound
                                                (fun a b =>
                                                  ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.frameMat θ
                                                        (c.modelCurlGrad
                                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2))
                                                        a b) -
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order 0 c.modelCurlGrad
                                                      p.1 p.2 a b)
                                                r.waveConst) →
                                        (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count),
                                            ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo r.box.r₁ r.box.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo r.box.z₁ r.box.z₂,
                                              p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                                ∀ (θ : ℝ),
                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.OpBound
                                                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classField c.order
                                                        (r.classes.modes i) c.modelStrain p θ)
                                                      (r.classes.strainDev i p) ∧
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.OpBound
                                                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classField c.order
                                                          (r.classes.modes i) c.modelCurlGrad p θ)
                                                        (r.classes.gradDev i p) ∧
                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq
                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classVec c.order
                                                              (r.classes.modes i) c.modelVelocity p θ) ≤
                                                          r.classes.velocityDev i p ^ 2 ∧
                                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq
                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classVec c.order
                                                              (r.classes.modes i) c.modelCurl p θ) ≤
                                                          r.classes.curlDev i p ^ 2) →
                                          (∀ (β : Fin (MD.harmonicCount + 1)),
                                              ↑↑β ∈ r.rows.yModes ∧ -↑↑β ∈ r.rows.yModes) →
                                            r.scalars.resolved ∪ r.scalars.band ⊆ r.rows.yModes →
                                              (∀ a ∈ r.rows.rowSet, r.rows.rowModeOf a ∈ r.scalars.resolved) →
                                                (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count) (n : ℤ),
                                                    n ∈ r.classes.modes i ↔ -n ∈ r.classes.modes i) →
                                                  (∀ (i j : Fin r.classes.count),
                                                      i ≠ j → Disjoint (r.classes.modes i) (r.classes.modes j)) →
                                                    (∀ n ∈ r.scalars.resolved,
                                                        ∀ n' ∉ r.scalars.resolved ∪ r.scalars.band,
                                                          ∀ (β : Fin (MD.harmonicCount + 1)),
                                                            ↑β ≤ MD.harmonicsOf r.meshCell →
                                                              n - n' = ↑↑β ∨ n - n' = -↑↑β →
                                                                ∃ i, n - n' ∈ r.classes.modes i) →
                                                      (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count),
                                                          r.classes.resolvedPart i ⊆ r.scalars.resolved) →
                                                        (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count),
                                                            ∀ n ∈ r.scalars.resolved,
                                                              (∃ n' ∉ r.scalars.resolved ∪ r.scalars.band,
                                                                  n - n' ∈ r.classes.modes i) →
                                                                n ∈ r.classes.resolvedPart i) →
                                                          (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count),
                                                              0 < r.classes.shareWeight i ∧ 0 < r.classes.rowWeight i) →
                                                            (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                                                0 ≤ r.classes.strainDev i p ∧
                                                                  0 ≤ r.classes.gradDev i p ∧
                                                                    0 ≤ r.classes.velocityDev i p ∧
                                                                      0 ≤ r.classes.curlDev i p) →
                                                              (∀ p ∈ r.box.rect,
                                                                  ∑ i,
                                                                        1 / 2 *
                                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst *
                                                                              r.classes.gradDev i p *
                                                                            r.scalars.splitLength /
                                                                          r.classes.shareWeight i ≤
                                                                      r.scalars.penaltyStrain ∧
                                                                    ∑ i,
                                                                          (r.classes.strainDev i p /
                                                                              r.classes.shareWeight i +
                                                                            2 * r.classes.rowWeight i *
                                                                              r.classes.velocityDev i p ^ 2) ≤
                                                                        r.scalars.penaltyCurl ∧
                                                                      ∑ i,
                                                                          (1 / 2 *
                                                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst *
                                                                                r.classes.gradDev i p /
                                                                              (r.scalars.splitLength *
                                                                                r.classes.shareWeight i) +
                                                                            2 * r.classes.rowWeight i *
                                                                              r.classes.curlDev i p ^ 2) ≤
                                                                        r.scalars.penaltyVelocity) →
                                                                0 < r.rows.farShare ∧ r.rows.farShare < 1 →
                                                                  (∀ (a b : Fin N),
                                                                      RD.cell a = RD.cell b →
                                                                        RD.harmonic a = RD.harmonic b →
                                                                          (a ∈ r.rows.rowSet ↔ b ∈ r.rows.rowSet)) →
                                                                    r.rows.multiplierMatrix =
                                                                        RD.mix *
                                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.testMultiplierOf
                                                                              c RD r *
                                                                          RD.mix.transpose →
                                                                      r.rows.reducer =
                                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.testReducerOf c
                                                                              RD r *
                                                                            RD.mix⁻¹ →
                                                                        r.systemMultiplier.IsSymm →
                                                                          (∀ (a b : Fin N),
                                                                              a ∉ r.rows.rowSet ∨ b ∉ r.rows.rowSet →
                                                                                r.systemMultiplier a b = 0) →
                                                                            (∀ a ∈ r.rows.rowSet,
                                                                                r.rows.classRowWeight a = ⋯) →
                                                                              (∀ (μ : Fin N → ℝ),
                                                                                  (∀ a ∉ r.rows.rowSet, μ a = 0) → ⋯) →
                                                                                0 < r.far.share →
                                                                                  0 ≤ r.far.turnBound → ⋯

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm.rec
declarations.type:
{k N : ℕ} →
  {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} →
    {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
      {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} →
        {W : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.WeightData} →
          {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm c K S W → Sort u} →
            ((resolved_eq : S.resolved = Finset.Icc (-↑W.J) ↑W.J) →
                (band_eq : S.band = Finset.Icc (-↑(W.J + W.JB)) ↑(W.J + W.JB) \ Finset.Icc (-↑W.J) ↑W.J) →
                  (energy_form : ∀ (n : ℤ), S.energyWeight n = W.energy) →
                    (vorticity_form : ∀ (n : ℤ), S.vorticityWeight n = W.vorticity) →
                      (shift_form : ∀ (n : ℤ), S.tailShift n = if n ∈ S.resolved then W.shift else 0) →
                        (curl_form :
                            ∀ (n : ℤ),
                              S.curlAbsorb n =
                                if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedCurl
                                else if n ∈ S.band then W.curlBand else W.curlOut) →
                          (strain_form :
                              ∀ (n : ℤ),
                                S.strainAbsorb n =
                                  if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedStrain
                                  else W.strainAt K S (W.kEff c.order n) (decide (n ∈ S.band))) →
                            (velocity_form :
                                ∀ (n : ℤ), S.velocityAbsorb n = if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedVelocity else 0) →
                              (sym_form :
                                  ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                    S.symWeight n j l =
                                      S.energyWeight n *
                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K j l +
                                              K.angularWeight n *
                                                max (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n - 2) 0 ^ 2) -
                                          S.strainAbsorb n -
                                        S.tailShift n) →
                                (anti_form :
                                    ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                      S.antiWeight n j l =
                                        (S.energyWeight n + 2 * S.vorticityWeight n) *
                                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K j l +
                                                  K.angularWeight n *
                                                    max (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n - 1) 0 ^
                                                      2) -
                                              2 * S.curlAbsorb n -
                                            S.strainAbsorb n -
                                          S.tailShift n) →
                                  (vel_form :
                                      ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                        S.velWeight n j l =
                                          (S.tailShift n *
                                              if S.degHigh ≤ j then Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen K j
                                              else Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen K l) -
                                            S.velocityAbsorb n) →
                                    motive ⋯) →
              (t : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm c K S W) → motive t
