declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellNumbers.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N},
  0 ≤ c.innerWeight →
    c.innerWeight ≤ c.splitVisc →
      (∀ (y : Breakdown.Space), √(c.cellWeight y) * ‖c.velocityError y‖ ≤ c.velocityLoss) →
        ∑ i, ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (c.actuatorGrad i y - c.modelActuatorGrad i y) ≤
            c.actuatorGradLoss ^ 2 →
          ∑ i, (c.rows fun y => c.actuator i y - c.modelActuator i y) ^ 2 ≤ c.actuatorLoss ^ 2 →
            ∑ i, ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space), Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (c.pin i y - c.modelPinField i y) ≤
                c.pinFieldLoss ^ 2 →
              0 ≤ c.centreLoss ∧
                  0 ≤ c.rateLoss ∧
                    0 ≤ c.strainLoss ∧
                      0 ≤ c.curlGradLoss ∧
                        0 ≤ c.velocityLoss ∧
                          0 ≤ c.curlLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.actuatorGradLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.actuatorLoss ∧ 0 ≤ c.pinFieldLoss →
                c.centreLoss + (c.strainLoss + √(7 / 2) * c.curlGradLoss) / c.weightMin +
                      c.actuatorGradLoss / (2 * c.multiplierScale * √c.weightMin) ≤
                    c.potLoss →
                  √c.rowMax * c.centreLoss + c.rateLoss + (c.velocityLoss + c.curlLoss) / √c.weightMin +
                        c.actuatorLoss / c.multiplierScale ≤
                      c.rowLoss →
                    c.pinFieldLoss / √c.weightMin ≤ c.pinLoss →
                      (∀ (a b : Fin N), c.blockIndex a = c.blockIndex b → c.rowWeight a = c.rowWeight b) →
                        0 ≤ c.baseCoef →
                          (∀ (i : Fin c.levelCount), 0 ≤ c.levelCoef i) →
                            (∀ (i : Fin c.levelCount), 0 < c.levelRate i) →
                              c.splitVisc ^ (1 / (α - 1)) ≤ c.cutoff →
                                (∀ (x : ℝ), 0 < x → x ≤ c.cutoff → c.ratioSymbol α x ≤ c.levelSum x) →
                                  c.gapSymbol α c.cutoff ^ 2 / (c.gapSymbol α c.cutoff + c.reducedCoercivity) ≤
                                      c.levelSum c.cutoff →
                                    (∀ (a : Fin N),
                                        c.rowWeight a *
                                            (c.baseCoef +
                                                ∑ i, c.levelCoef i * c.spectralBound (c.blockIndex a) (c.levelRate i) +
                                              (α - 1) * c.tailConst * c.cutoff ^ (α - 1 - 1 / 2) / (1 / 2 - (α - 1))) ≤
                                          c.splitBound ^ 2) →
                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellNumbers α c

declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {W : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.WeightData},
  3 ≤ c.order →
    0 < W.energy →
      W.energy ≤ c.innerWeight - c.coercivity →
        0 ≤ W.vorticity →
          W.vorticity ≤ c.splitVisc - c.innerWeight →
            0 ≤ W.shift →
              0 < S.weightFloor →
                0 ≤ W.rLo →
                  (∀ p ∈ K.rect,
                      p.1 ≠ 0 →
                        W.rLo ≤ Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p ∧
                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat K p ≤ W.rHi) →
                    (∀ p ∈ K.rect, Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst * S.meanGradBound p ≤ 2 * W.meanConst) →
                      (∀ p ∈ K.rect, Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst * S.waveGradBound p ≤ 2 * W.waveConst) →
                        (∀ p ∈ K.rect, S.strainBound p ≤ W.lamMax) →
                          (∀ p ∈ K.rect, Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.sampleWeight c p ≤ W.weightMax) →
                            0 < S.splitLength →
                              0 ≤ W.meanConst ∧ 0 ≤ W.waveConst ∧ 0 ≤ c.coercivity →
                                0 ≤ S.penaltyStrain ∧ 0 ≤ S.penaltyCurl ∧ 0 ≤ S.penaltyVelocity →
                                  max (W.rLo * (W.lamMax - (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight)))
                                        (W.rHi * (W.lamMax - (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight))) ≤
                                      W.curlBand →
                                    max (W.rLo * (W.lamMax + S.penaltyCurl - (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight)))
                                          (W.rHi * (W.lamMax + S.penaltyCurl - (1 - 3 / (4 * α) - c.curlWeight))) ≤
                                        W.curlOut →
                                      max
                                            (W.rLo *
                                              (W.waveConst * S.splitLength -
                                                (c.curlWeight - c.coercivity * W.weightMax)))
                                            (W.rHi *
                                              (W.waveConst * S.splitLength -
                                                (c.curlWeight - c.coercivity * W.weightMax))) ≤
                                          W.strainBase →
                                        W.rHi * W.waveConst / S.splitLength ≤ W.strainQuad →
                                          S.weightFloor ≤
                                              W.energy *
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K
                                                      (S.degHigh + 1) 0 -
                                                  W.resolvedStrain -
                                                W.shift →
                                            S.weightFloor ≤
                                                W.energy *
                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K 0
                                                        (S.degHigh + 1) -
                                                    W.resolvedStrain -
                                                  W.shift →
                                              S.weightFloor ≤
                                                  (W.energy + 2 * W.vorticity) *
                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K
                                                            (S.degHigh + 1) 0 -
                                                        2 * W.resolvedCurl -
                                                      W.resolvedStrain -
                                                    W.shift →
                                                S.weightFloor ≤
                                                    (W.energy + 2 * W.vorticity) *
                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K 0
                                                              (S.degHigh + 1) -
                                                          2 * W.resolvedCurl -
                                                        W.resolvedStrain -
                                                      W.shift →
                                                  S.weightFloor ≤ W.symAt K S 0 0 (↑(W.J + 1) * ↑c.order) true →
                                                    S.weightFloor ≤
                                                        W.symAt K S 0 0 (↑(W.J + W.JB + 1) * ↑c.order) false →
                                                      S.weightFloor ≤ W.antiAt K S 0 0 (↑(W.J + 1) * ↑c.order) true →
                                                        S.weightFloor ≤
                                                            W.antiAt K S 0 0 (↑(W.J + W.JB + 1) * ↑c.order) false →
                                                          S.weightFloor ≤
                                                              W.shift *
                                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen K
                                                                    S.degHigh -
                                                                W.resolvedVelocity →
                                                            S.weightFloor ≤

∀ {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox}
  {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases}
  {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout},
  Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L →
    (∀ n ∈ L.modes, -n ∈ L.modes) →
      (∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
          (L.presSegment s).radial = true ∧
              ((L.presSegment s).level = K.r₁ ∨ (L.presSegment s).level = K.r₂) ∧
                K.z₁ ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo ∧ (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ K.z₂ ∧ (L.presSegment s).level ≠ 0 ∨
            ¬(L.presSegment s).radial = true ∧
              ((L.presSegment s).level = K.z₁ ∨ (L.presSegment s).level = K.z₂) ∧
                K.r₁ ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo ∧ (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →
        (∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
            ((L.presSegment s).radial = true → (L.presSegment s).other = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.presSegment s).level) ∧
              (¬(L.presSegment s).radial = true → (L.presSegment s).other = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.presSegment s).level)) →
          (∀ (e : Fin 4),
              (↑e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                ∀ (u : ℝ),
                  (if ↑e < 2 then K.z₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.z₂ else K.r₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.r₂) →
                    ∃ s,
                      ((L.presSegment s).radial = true ↔ ↑e < 2) ∧
                        ((L.presSegment s).level =
                            if ↑e = 0 then K.r₁ else if ↑e = 1 then K.r₂ else if ↑e = 2 then K.z₁ else K.z₂) ∧
                          (L.presSegment s).lo ≤ u ∧ u ≤ (L.presSegment s).hi) →
            (∀ (s s' : Fin L.presCount),
                s ≠ s' →
                  (L.presSegment s).radial = (L.presSegment s').radial →
                    (L.presSegment s).level = (L.presSegment s').level →
                      (L.presSegment s).hi ≤ (L.presSegment s').lo ∨ (L.presSegment s').hi ≤ (L.presSegment s).lo) →
              (∀ (s : Fin L.presCount) (d d' : ℕ),
                  d < L.degSide →
                    d' < L.degSide →
                      ∫ (u : ℝ) in Set.Icc (L.presSegment s).lo (L.presSegment s).hi,
                          (L.presSegment s).test d u * (L.presSegment s).test d' u =
                        if d = d' then 1 else 0) →
                Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsPressureLayout c K S B L

                                                (penalties_nonneg :

                                                            (W.rHi *
                                                              (W.lamMax + S.penaltyCurl -

                                                          W.curlOut) →
                                                      (strain_base_ge :
                                                          max
                                                              (W.rLo *
                                                                (W.waveConst * S.splitLength -
                                                                  (c.curlWeight - c.coercivity * W.weightMax)))
                                                              (W.rHi *
                                                                (W.waveConst * S.splitLength -
                                                                  (c.curlWeight - c.coercivity * W.weightMax))) ≤
                                                            W.strainBase) →
                                                        (strain_quad_ge :
                                                            W.rHi * W.waveConst / S.splitLength ≤ W.strainQuad) →
                                                          (sym_resolved_radial :
                                                              S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                W.energy *
                                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                        K (S.degHigh + 1) 0 -
                                                                    W.resolvedStrain -
                                                                  W.shift) →

                                                                  W.energy *
                                                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                          K 0 (S.degHigh + 1) -
                                                                      W.resolvedStrain -
                                                                    W.shift) →

                                                                    (W.energy + 2 * W.vorticity) *
                                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam
                                                                              K (S.degHigh + 1) 0 -

                                                                        W.resolvedStrain -

                                                                              true) →
                                                                        (anti_out :
                                                                            S.weightFloor ≤
                                                                              W.antiAt K S 0 0
                                                                                (↑(W.J + W.JB + 1) * ↑c.order) false) →
                                                                          (vel_radial :

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout.rec
declarations.type:
{k N : ℕ} →
  {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} →
    {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
      {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} →
        {B : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBases} →
          {L : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.CellLayout} →
            {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L → Sort u} →
              ((order_eq : L.order = c.order) →
                  (box_eq : L.box = K) →
                    (bases_eq : L.bases = B) →
                      (modes_eq : L.modes = S.resolved) →
                        (degCoef_eq : L.degCoef = S.degHigh) →
                          (degSide_eq : L.degSide = S.degLow) →
                            (box_valid : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBox K) →
                              (bases_valid : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.IsCellBases K B) →
                                (segment_valid :
                                    ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (L.segment s)) →
                                  (presSegment_valid :
                                      ∀ (s : Fin L.presCount),
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (L.presSegment s)) →
                                    (gauge_valid :
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment L.gauge ∧
                                          L.gauge.testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧ 0 ≤ L.gauge.lo) →
                                      (segment_on_side :
                                          ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                            (L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                                ((L.segment s).level = K.r₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.r₂) ∧
                                                  K.z₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧
                                                    (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.z₂ ∧ (L.segment s).level ≠ 0 ∨
                                              ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧
                                                ((L.segment s).level = K.z₁ ∨ (L.segment s).level = K.z₂) ∧
                                                  K.r₁ ≤ (L.segment s).lo ∧ (L.segment s).hi ≤ K.r₂) →
                                        (segment_other_in_box :
                                            ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                              ((L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                  (L.segment s).other = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.segment s).level) ∧
                                                (¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                  (L.segment s).other = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.segment s).level)) →
                                          (corner_is_corner :
                                              ∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                ((L.corner c).1 = K.r₁ ∨ (L.corner c).1 = K.r₂) ∧
                                                  ((L.corner c).2 = K.z₁ ∨ (L.corner c).2 = K.z₂) ∧
                                                    (L.corner c).1 ≠ 0) →
                                            (corner_other :
                                                ∀ (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                  (L.cornerOther c).1 = K.r₁ + K.r₂ - (L.corner c).1 ∧
                                                    (L.cornerOther c).2 = K.z₁ + K.z₂ - (L.corner c).2) →
                                              (segEnd_spec :
                                                  ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                    L.segEnd s e = some c →
                                                      L.corner c =
                                                        if (L.segment s).radial = true then
                                                          ((L.segment s).level,
                                                            if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi)
                                                        else
                                                          (if e = 0 then (L.segment s).lo else (L.segment s).hi,
                                                            (L.segment s).level)) →
                                                (segEnd_axis :
                                                    ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (e : Fin 2),
                                                      L.segEnd s e = none →
                                                        ¬(L.segment s).radial = true ∧ e = 0 ∧ (L.segment s).lo = 0) →
                                                  (radial_test_const :
                                                      ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                        (L.segment s).radial = true → (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0) →
                                                    (height_test_affine :
                                                        ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                          ¬(L.segment s).radial = true →
                                                            (L.segment s).testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                                                              (L.segment s).testCoef 1 1 ≠ 0) →
                                                      (degSide_pos : 1 ≤ L.degSide) →
                                                        (degSide_le : L.degSide + 1 ≤ L.degCoef) →
                                                          (cellCorner_spec :
                                                              ∀ (i j : Fin 2) (c : Fin L.cornerCount),
                                                                L.cellCorner i j = some c →
                                                                  L.corner c =
                                                                    (if i = 0 then K.r₁ else K.r₂,
                                                                      if j = 0 then K.z₁ else K.z₂)) →
                                                            (cellCorner_axis :
                                                                ∀ (i j : Fin 2),
                                                                  L.cellCorner i j = none → i = 0 ∧ K.r₁ = 0) →
                                                              (sideSegments_spec :
                                                                  ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                    ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                      ((L.segment s).radial = true ↔ ↑e < 2) ∧
                                                                        (L.segment s).level =
                                                                          if ↑e = 0 then K.r₁
                                                                          else
                                                                            if ↑e = 1 then K.r₂
                                                                            else if ↑e = 2 then K.z₁ else K.z₂) →
                                                                (sideSegments_cover :
                                                                    ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                      (↑e = 0 → K.r₁ ≠ 0) →
                                                                        ∀ (u : ℝ),
                                                                          (if ↑e < 2 then K.z₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.z₂
                                                                            else K.r₁ ≤ u ∧ u ≤ K.r₂) →
                                                                            ∃ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                              (L.segment s).lo ≤ u ∧
                                                                                u ≤ (L.segment s).hi) →
                                                                  (sideSegments_disjoint :
                                                                      ∀ (e : Fin 4),
                                                                        ∀ s ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                          ∀ s' ∈ L.sideSegments e,
                                                                            s ≠ s' →
                                                                              (L.segment s).hi ≤ (L.segment s').lo ∨
                                                                                (L.segment s').hi ≤ (L.segment s).lo) →
                                                                    (segments_on_sides :
                                                                        ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount),
                                                                          ∃ e, s ∈ L.sideSegments e) →
                                                                      (segment_orthonormal :
                                                                          ∀ (s : Fin L.segCount) (d d' : ℕ),
                                                                            d ≤ L.degSide + 1 →
                                                                              d' ≤ L.degSide + 1 →
                                                                                ∫ (u : ℝ) in
                                                                                    Set.Icc (L.segment s).lo
                                                                                      (L.segment s).hi,
                                                                                    (L.segment s).test d u *
                                                                                      (L.segment s).test d' u =
                                                                                  if d = d' then 1 else 0) →
                                                                        motive ⋯) →
                (t : Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsCellLayout c K S B L) → motive t

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.IsCellSystemFacts.mk._flat_ctor
declarations.type:
∀ {α : ℝ} {k N : ℕ} {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} {M : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.CellMesh}
  {MD : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.ModelData M k} {RD : Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.RowData M N}
  {Sp : Breakdown.CellCert.Assembly.CellSplit k N} {K₂ : Fin Sp.cellCount}
  {r : Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.CellEntry M N k Sp.slots}
  {C : Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.CellCoords k Sp.slots},
  Breakdown.CellCert.GivenModel.IsRowsInstance c M RD r.meshCell r.rows →
    Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm c r.box r.scalars r.weights →
      (∀ n ∉ r.scalars.resolved, ∀ (p : ℝ × ℝ), r.scalars.localMatrix n p = 0) →
        Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsResolvedTests α c r.scalars r.weights r.strainScalar r.lowConst →
          (r.scalars.strainBound = fun x => r.strainConst) →
            (r.scalars.meanGradBound = fun x => r.meanConst) →
              (r.scalars.waveGradBound = fun x => r.waveConst) →
                (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                    r.classes.strainDev i p =
                        r.devConst 0 i + r.devSlope 0 i * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat r.box p ∧
                      r.classes.gradDev i p =
                          r.devConst 1 i + r.devSlope 1 i * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat r.box p ∧
                        r.classes.velocityDev i p =
                            r.devConst 2 i + r.devSlope 2 i * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat r.box p ∧
                          r.classes.curlDev i p =
                            r.devConst 3 i +
                              r.devSlope 3 i * Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.rHat r.box p) →
                  Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightTests α c r.box r.scalars r.weights →
                    (r.box.IsAxis → r.weights.J = 0) →
                      3 ≤ r.scalars.degLow ∧
                          r.scalars.degLow + 2 ≤ r.scalars.degHigh ∧ r.scalars.degHigh + 1 ≤ r.scalars.degNear →
                        RD.degree + 2 ≤ r.scalars.degHigh →
                          MD.columnDegree + 1 ≤ r.scalars.degNear →
                            RD.degree + MD.degree + 2 ≤ r.rowDegree →
                              0 ≤ r.meanConst ∧ 0 ≤ r.waveConst →
                                Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsGivenBases r.box r.baseDegree r.givenBases →
                                  (∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo r.box.r₁ r.box.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo r.box.z₁ r.box.z₂,
                                      p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                        ∀ (θ : ℝ) (u : Breakdown.Space),
                                          inner ℝ
                                              ((c.modelStrain (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2)) u)
                                              u ≤
                                            r.strainConst * ‖u‖ ^ 2) →
                                    (∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo r.box.r₁ r.box.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo r.box.z₁ r.box.z₂,
                                        p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.OpBound
                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order 0 c.modelCurlGrad p.1 p.2)
                                            r.meanConst) →
                                      (∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo r.box.r₁ r.box.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo r.box.z₁ r.box.z₂,
                                          p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                            ∀ (θ : ℝ),
                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.OpBound
                                                (fun a b =>
                                                  ↑(Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.frameMat θ
                                                        (c.modelCurlGrad
                                                          (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.cylPoint p.1 θ p.2))
                                                        a b) -
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeMat c.order 0 c.modelCurlGrad
                                                      p.1 p.2 a b)
                                                r.waveConst) →
                                        (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count),
                                            ∀ p ∈ Set.Ioo r.box.r₁ r.box.r₂ ×ˢ Set.Ioo r.box.z₁ r.box.z₂,
                                              p.1 ≠ 0 →
                                                ∀ (θ : ℝ),
                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.OpBound
                                                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classField c.order
                                                        (r.classes.modes i) c.modelStrain p θ)
                                                      (r.classes.strainDev i p) ∧
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.OpBound
                                                        (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classField c.order
                                                          (r.classes.modes i) c.modelCurlGrad p θ)
                                                        (r.classes.gradDev i p) ∧
                                                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq
                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classVec c.order
                                                              (r.classes.modes i) c.modelVelocity p θ) ≤
                                                          r.classes.velocityDev i p ^ 2 ∧
                                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.vecSq
                                                            (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classVec c.order
                                                              (r.classes.modes i) c.modelCurl p θ) ≤
                                                          r.classes.curlDev i p ^ 2) →
                                          (∀ (β : Fin (MD.harmonicCount + 1)),
                                              ↑↑β ∈ r.rows.yModes ∧ -↑↑β ∈ r.rows.yModes) →
                                            r.scalars.resolved ∪ r.scalars.band ⊆ r.rows.yModes →
                                              (∀ a ∈ r.rows.rowSet, r.rows.rowModeOf a ∈ r.scalars.resolved) →
                                                (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count) (n : ℤ),
                                                    n ∈ r.classes.modes i ↔ -n ∈ r.classes.modes i) →
                                                  (∀ (i j : Fin r.classes.count),
                                                      i ≠ j → Disjoint (r.classes.modes i) (r.classes.modes j)) →
                                                    (∀ n ∈ r.scalars.resolved,
                                                        ∀ n' ∉ r.scalars.resolved ∪ r.scalars.band,
                                                          ∀ (β : Fin (MD.harmonicCount + 1)),
                                                            ↑β ≤ MD.harmonicsOf r.meshCell →
                                                              n - n' = ↑↑β ∨ n - n' = -↑↑β →
                                                                ∃ i, n - n' ∈ r.classes.modes i) →
                                                      (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count),
                                                          r.classes.resolvedPart i ⊆ r.scalars.resolved) →
                                                        (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count),
                                                            ∀ n ∈ r.scalars.resolved,
                                                              (∃ n' ∉ r.scalars.resolved ∪ r.scalars.band,
                                                                  n - n' ∈ r.classes.modes i) →
                                                                n ∈ r.classes.resolvedPart i) →
                                                          (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count),
                                                              0 < r.classes.shareWeight i ∧ 0 < r.classes.rowWeight i) →
                                                            (∀ (i : Fin r.classes.count) (p : ℝ × ℝ),
                                                                0 ≤ r.classes.strainDev i p ∧
                                                                  0 ≤ r.classes.gradDev i p ∧
                                                                    0 ≤ r.classes.velocityDev i p ∧
                                                                      0 ≤ r.classes.curlDev i p) →
                                                              (∀ p ∈ r.box.rect,
                                                                  ∑ i,
                                                                        1 / 2 *
                                                                                Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst *
                                                                              r.classes.gradDev i p *
                                                                            r.scalars.splitLength /
                                                                          r.classes.shareWeight i ≤
                                                                      r.scalars.penaltyStrain ∧
                                                                    ∑ i,
                                                                          (r.classes.strainDev i p /
                                                                              r.classes.shareWeight i +
                                                                            2 * r.classes.rowWeight i *
                                                                              r.classes.velocityDev i p ^ 2) ≤
                                                                        r.scalars.penaltyCurl ∧
                                                                      ∑ i,
                                                                          (1 / 2 *
                                                                                  Breakdown.CellCert.Exterior.traceFreeConst *
                                                                                r.classes.gradDev i p /
                                                                              (r.scalars.splitLength *
                                                                                r.classes.shareWeight i) +
                                                                            2 * r.classes.rowWeight i *
                                                                              r.classes.curlDev i p ^ 2) ≤
                                                                        r.scalars.penaltyVelocity) →
                                                                0 < r.rows.farShare ∧ r.rows.farShare < 1 →
                                                                  (∀ (a b : Fin N),
                                                                      RD.cell a = RD.cell b →
                                                                        RD.harmonic a = RD.harmonic b →
                                                                          (a ∈ r.rows.rowSet ↔ b ∈ r.rows.rowSet)) →
                                                                    r.rows.multiplierMatrix =
                                                                        RD.mix *
                                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.testMultiplierOf
                                                                              c RD r *
                                                                          RD.mix.transpose →
                                                                      r.rows.reducer =
                                                                          Breakdown.CellCert.CellSystem.testReducerOf c
                                                                              RD r *
                                                                            RD.mix⁻¹ →
                                                                        r.systemMultiplier.IsSymm →
                                                                          (∀ (a b : Fin N),
                                                                              a ∉ r.rows.rowSet ∨ b ∉ r.rows.rowSet →
                                                                                r.systemMultiplier a b = 0) →
                                                                            (∀ a ∈ r.rows.rowSet,
                                                                                r.rows.classRowWeight a = ⋯) →
                                                                              (∀ (μ : Fin N → ℝ),
                                                                                  (∀ a ∉ r.rows.rowSet, μ a = 0) → ⋯) →
                                                                                0 < r.far.share →

        {M : Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.MeshData k N Sp} →
          {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.IsMeshData α c Sp M → Sort u} →
            ((gauge_specs :
                  ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsGaugeSpec (M.coords K).layout (M.coords K).gaugeSpec) →
                (gauge_valid :
                    ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                      Breakdown.CellCert.CellFormula.IsFaceSegment (M.coords K).layout.gauge ∧
                        (M.coords K).layout.gauge.testCoef 0 0 ≠ 0 ∧
                          0 ≤ (M.coords K).layout.gauge.lo ∧
                            ((M.coords K).layout.gauge.radial = true →
                              (M.coords K).layout.gauge.level ≠ 0 ∧
                                0 ≤ min (M.coords K).layout.gauge.level (M.coords K).layout.gauge.other)) →
                  (gauge_canonical :
                      ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                        (M.coords K).gaugeLeft = M.canonicalLeft K ∧ (M.coords K).gaugeRight = M.canonicalRight K) →
                    (kappa_injective : Function.Injective Sp.kappaSlot) →
                      (kappa_unowned :
                          ∀ (a : Fin k) (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
                            (j :
                              Fin
                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords (M.coords K).layout
                                    (M.coords K).param).card),
                            (M.coords K).Tmap j (Sp.kappaSlot a) = 0) →
                        (delay_injective : Function.Injective M.delaySlot) →
                          (delay_not_kappa : ∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (a : Fin k), M.delaySlot j ≠ Sp.kappaSlot a) →
                            (delay_unowned :
                                ∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
                                  (r :
                                    Fin
                                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords (M.coords K).layout
                                          (M.coords K).param).card),
                                  (M.coords K).Tmap r (M.delaySlot j) = 0) →
                              (expansion_base : ∀ (i : Fin Sp.slots), ∀ p ∈ M.delayExpansion i, ¬M.IsDelaySlot p.1) →
                                (expansion_consistent :
                                    ∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (l : Fin Sp.slots),
                                      ¬M.IsDelaySlot l →
                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.rowEntries (M.delayExpansion (M.delaySlot j))
                                            l =
                                          (List.map
                                              (fun p =>
                                                p.2 *
                                                  if M.IsDelaySlot p.1 then
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.rowEntries (M.delayExpansion p.1)
                                                      l
                                                  else if p.1 = l then 1 else 0)
                                              (M.delayRow j)).sum) →
                                  (delay_free :
                                      ∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount) (i : Fin k),
                                        Sp.freeMap (M.delaySlot j) i =
                                          (List.map (fun p => p.2 * Sp.freeMap p.1 i) (M.delayRow j)).sum) →
                                    (delay_form :
                                        ∀ (j : Fin Sp.delayCount),
                                          Sp.delayForm j = Matrix.vecMulVec (M.delayVector j) (M.delayVector j)) →
                                      (rows :
                                          ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount)
                                            (j :
                                              Fin
                                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.systemSkeletonCoords
                                                    (M.coords K).layout (M.coords K).param).card),
                                            ∃ parts extra,
                                              (∀ (i' : Fin Sp.slots),
                                                  (M.coords K).Tmap j i' =
                                                    Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.rowEntries parts i') ∧
                                                (∀ p ∈ parts, ∀ (a : Fin k), Sp.kappaSlot a ≠ p.1) ∧
                                                  (∀ p ∈ parts, ¬M.IsDelaySlot p.1) ∧
                                                    (∀ p ∈ parts,
                                                        (M.rowDatum (M.ownerCell p.1) (M.ownerRow p.1)).2 =
                                                          (M.rowDatum K j).2) ∧
                                                      (∀ e ∈ extra, (M.coords e.fst).layout.IsGaugeDeleted e.snd.1) ∧
                                                        ((extra = [] ∧
                                                              ∃ i,
                                                                parts = [(i, 1)] ∧
                                                                  M.rowKey K j = M.ownerKey i ∧
                                                                    (M.rowKey K j =
                                                                        Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.SkeletonKey.private_ →
                                                                      M.ownerCell i = K ∧ M.ownerRow i ≍ j)) ∨
                                                            Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.SegmentSplit
                                                                (M.rowKey K j)
                                                                (List.map (fun p => (M.ownerKey p.1, p.2)) parts ++
                                                                  M.extraKeys extra) ∨
                                                              Breakdown.CellCert.CellCoordinates.FluxSplit
                                                                  (M.rowKey K j)
                                                                  (List.map (fun p => (M.ownerKey p.1, p.2)) parts ++
                                                                    M.extraKeys extra) ∨
                                                                parts = [] ∧
                                                                  extra = [] ∧ M.DeletedKey K j (M.rowKey K j)) ∧
                                                          ∀ u ∈ M.participantNodes K j parts ++ M.extraNodes extra,
                                                            ∀ v ∈ M.participantNodes K j parts ++ M.extraNodes extra,
                                                              u.1 = v.1 → u.2 = v.2) →
                                        (owner_row :
                                            ∀ (i : Fin Sp.slots),
                                              (∀ (a : Fin k), Sp.kappaSlot a ≠ i) →
                                                ¬M.IsDelaySlot i →
                                                  ∀ (i' : Fin Sp.slots),
                                                    (M.coords (M.ownerCell i)).Tmap (M.ownerRow i) i' =
                                                      if i' = i then 1 else 0) →
                                          (same_order : ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount), (M.coords K).layout.order = c.order) →
                                            (same_gauge :
                                                ∀ (K K' : Fin Sp.cellCount),
                                                  (M.coords K).layout.gauge = (M.coords K').layout.gauge) →
                                              (radial_segments :
                                                  ∀ (K : Fin Sp.cellCount) (s : Fin (M.coords K).layout.segCount),
                                                    ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).radial = true →
                                                      ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).level ≠ 0 ∧
                                                        0 ≤
                                                          min ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).level
                                                            ((M.coords K).layout.segment s).other) →
                                                (radial_pressure_segments :

declarations.name: Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm.casesOn
declarations.type:
{k N : ℕ} →
  {c : Breakdown.CellCert.FracCellData k N} →
    {K : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellBox} →
      {S : Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars} →
        {W : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.WeightData} →
          {motive : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm c K S W → Sort u} →
            (t : Breakdown.CellCert.Reduction.IsWeightForm c K S W) →
              ((resolved_eq : S.resolved = Finset.Icc (-↑W.J) ↑W.J) →
                  (band_eq : S.band = Finset.Icc (-↑(W.J + W.JB)) ↑(W.J + W.JB) \ Finset.Icc (-↑W.J) ↑W.J) →
                    (energy_form : ∀ (n : ℤ), S.energyWeight n = W.energy) →
                      (vorticity_form : ∀ (n : ℤ), S.vorticityWeight n = W.vorticity) →
                        (shift_form : ∀ (n : ℤ), S.tailShift n = if n ∈ S.resolved then W.shift else 0) →
                          (curl_form :
                              ∀ (n : ℤ),
                                S.curlAbsorb n =
                                  if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedCurl
                                  else if n ∈ S.band then W.curlBand else W.curlOut) →
                            (strain_form :
                                ∀ (n : ℤ),
                                  S.strainAbsorb n =
                                    if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedStrain
                                    else W.strainAt K S (W.kEff c.order n) (decide (n ∈ S.band))) →
                              (velocity_form :
                                  ∀ (n : ℤ), S.velocityAbsorb n = if n ∈ S.resolved then W.resolvedVelocity else 0) →
                                (sym_form :
                                    ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                      S.symWeight n j l =
                                        S.energyWeight n *
                                              (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K j l +
                                                K.angularWeight n *
                                                  max (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n - 2) 0 ^
                                                    2) -
                                            S.strainAbsorb n -
                                          S.tailShift n) →
                                  (anti_form :
                                      ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                        S.antiWeight n j l =
                                          (S.energyWeight n + 2 * S.vorticityWeight n) *
                                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.CellScalars.tailLam K j l +
                                                    K.angularWeight n *
                                                      max (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.modeNumber c.order n - 1) 0 ^
                                                        2) -
                                                2 * S.curlAbsorb n -
                                              S.strainAbsorb n -
                                            S.tailShift n) →
                                    (vel_form :
                                        ∀ (n : ℤ) (j l : ℕ),
                                          S.velWeight n j l =
                                            (S.tailShift n *
                                                if S.degHigh ≤ j then Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.radialEigen K j
                                                else Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.heightEigen K l) -
                                              S.velocityAbsorb n) →
                                      motive ⋯) →
                motive t

                  (pinWeight_pos : 0 < d.pinWeight) →
                    (rowMax_pos : 0 < d.rowMax) →
                      (multiplierScale_pos : 0 < d.multiplierScale) →
                        (radius_nonneg : ∀ (j : Fin k), 0 ≤ d.radius j) →
                          (slope_ne_zero : ∀ (j : Fin k), d.slope j ≠ 0) →
                            (ellipsoidRadius_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.ellipsoidRadius) →
                              (ellipsoid_le : ∀ j ∉ d.activeSet, d.ellipsoidRadius ≤ |d.slope j| * d.radius j) →
                                (frame_near :
                                    ∀ (z : Fin k → ℝ),
                                      |∑ j, d.frame.mulVec z j ^ 2 - ∑ j, z j ^ 2| ≤ d.frameDefect * ∑ j, z j ^ 2) →
                                  (frameDefect_lt : d.frameDefect < 1) →
                                    (pinGap_bound :
                                        ∑ l,
                                            ∫ (y : Breakdown.Space),
                                              Breakdown.SteadyCert.entrySq (d.smoothPin l y - d.pin l y) ≤
                                          d.pinGap ^ 2) →
                                      (pinGap_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.pinGap) →
                                        (losses_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.potLoss ∧ 0 ≤ d.rowLoss ∧ 0 ≤ d.pinLoss) →
                                          (reduced_pos : 0 < d.reducedCoercivity) →
                                            (reduced_le : d.reducedCoercivity ≤ d.coercivity - d.potLoss) →
                                              (lowLoss_bound :
                                                  ∀ (κ₀ : ℝ),
                                                    0 < κ₀ →
                                                      max (d.splitVisc - κ₀ ^ (2 * (α - 1))) 0 ≤
                                                        d.lowLoss * (1 + d.weightMin / κ₀ ^ 2)) →
                                                (reducedGap_pos : 0 < d.reducedGap) →
                                                  (formScale_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.formScale) →
                                                    (formScale_bound :
                                                        ∀ (κ₀ : ℝ),
                                                          0 < κ₀ →
                                                            1 ≤
                                                              d.formScale ^ 2 *
                                                                (κ₀ ^ (2 * (α - 1)) - d.splitVisc +
                                                                  d.reducedCoercivity * (1 + d.weightMin / κ₀ ^ 2))) →
                                                      (splitBound_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.splitBound) →
                                                        (contraction_lt : d.contraction < 1) →
                                                          (productConst_nonneg : 0 ≤ d.productConst) →
                                                            (defect_norm :
                                                                ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                  Breakdown.SteadyCert.projectedNorm (d.defect α p) ≤
                                                                    d.defectBound) →
                                                              (defect_rows :
                                                                  ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                    d.rowsModGrad (d.defect α p) ≤ d.defectRowBound) →
                                                                (size_ge :
                                                                    d.boundFn d.defectBound d.defectRowBound 0 ≤
                                                                      d.sizeBound) →
                                                                  (size_small :
                                                                      4 * d.rowConst * d.productConst * d.sizeBound <
                                                                        1) →
                                                                    (adjointQuad_nonneg :
                                                                        ∀ j ∈ d.activeSet,
                                                                          ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                            0 ≤ d.adjointQuad j p) →
                                                                      (active_inclusion :
                                                                          ∀ j ∈ d.activeSet,
                                                                            ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                              ∀ p' ∈ d.testBox,
                                                                                d.adjointQuad j p * d.heldRadius ^ 2 +
                                                                                      d.heldRadius *
                                                                                        √((d.adjointLocal j p +
                                                                                                  d.adjointSpread j p +
                                                                                                Breakdown.SteadyCert.vecNorm
                                                                                                      (d.adjointPin j
                                                                                                        p) *
                                                                                                    d.pinGap /
                                                                                                  √d.weightMin) ^
                                                                                              2 +
                                                                                            Breakdown.SteadyCert.vecNorm
                                                                                                  (d.adjointError j p) ^
                                                                                                2 /
                                                                                              d.multiplierScale ^ 2) +
                                                                                    |d.adjustedMultiplier α p' j| ≤
                                                                                  |d.slope j| * d.radius j) →
                                                                        (stiff_inclusion :
                                                                            ∀ p' ∈ d.testBox,
                                                                              √(1 + d.frameDefect) * d.heldRadius /
                                                                                    d.multiplierScale +
                                                                                  √(∑ j ∈ d.activeSetᶜ,
                                                                                      (d.frame.transpose.mulVec
                                                                                            (d.multiplier p') j -
                                                                                          d.slope j * p' j) ^
                                                                                        2) ≤
                                                                                d.ellipsoidRadius) →
                                                                          (nontrivial :
                                                                              ∀ p ∈ Breakdown.SteadyCert.box d.radius,
                                                                                d.heldRadius / √d.weightMin <

                                                                                (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classField
                                                                                  c.order (r.classes.modes i)
                                                                                  c.modelStrain p θ)
                                                                                (r.classes.strainDev i p) ∧

                                                                                  (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classField
                                                                                    c.order (r.classes.modes i)
                                                                                    c.modelCurlGrad p θ)
                                                                                  (r.classes.gradDev i p) ∧

                                                                                      (Breakdown.CellCert.CellAnalysis.classVec
                                                                                        c.order (r.classes.modes i)
                                                                                        c.modelCurl p θ) ≤
